chapters.title: Chapter 851 Second Hand Embarrassment
paragraphs: Almost everyone in the audience was singing praises of Petonil.
While the man in question stood at the front with his arms folded, wearing no expression,
as if they weren't just talking about him.
Petonil looked similar to his son, but had a long beard that was nearly a meter long, reaching all the way down.
He had a habit of constantly running his fingers through his beard.
"Welcome, Sir Petonil." The man making the announcement greeted him.
While last time he didn't even speak directly to Petophil, was this guy really that capable?
"Thank you." Petonil finally looked straight ahead, puffed out his chest, and greeted, "Hello, Miss Vespera."
"Hmm." Evelyn didn't look up from the papers and merely hummed. He might be respected all across the universe and be a god,
but to the higher beings, his status was still that of a servant.
And although he was very capable, he had only managed to come this far and earn so much respect because he had good connections with the higher beings,
even having participated in their court cases.
Petonil didn't mind the lack of a proper greeting. He simply waited for the case to properly begin.
"..." Evelyn already knew most of the details of this case, even more than the gods themselves.
But she still went through everything, trying her best not to leave anything out.
After she finished, the gorgeous blonde finally raised her head and ran her gaze across the courtroom.
Finally pausing at Vritra, lingering there briefly before gesturing with her hand.
"The hearing shall now begin!" the man in black shouted.
But Petonil had been observing Evelyn, and he clearly saw that her gaze had paused at Vritra.
'So, just as my good-for-nothing son had said. She really helped him last time. No wonder he lost such an easy case.'
Petonil suddenly felt he might have been too harsh on his son.
Although the judge herself was against him, Petonil didn't feel any fear.
He had heard a little about Evelyn and knew she was going to be the next family head.
But with her marriage into the Garissa family, that would become impossible.
Her mother was said to have died a long time ago, or so Fader had declared, though not many had actually seen her.
And her new mother was more than happy to send her away.
"Then I will start." Petonil took the initiative, and Vritra didn't mind, having faith in Evelyn.
"Go ahead, start with a briefing." Evelyn spoke, after all, the people in the courtroom didn't know what had happened this time.

"Vritra Arclis and his group are guilty of having committed several crimes. Not only did he enter the gods' office, steal the entry tokens, completely mess up the arrangements, and force four games to take place simultaneously on the same planet!"

Petonil paused before continuing, "Then these ten entered the games, slaughtered the teams of Level 3 and Level 4 Demi Gods, killed many Level 5 and Level 6 Demi Gods, and completely ruined the games! This resulted in a countless waste of resources, many deaths, and numerous other damages."
Hearing this, the people grew even more animated, chattering in shock at how much this group had done.
It was far more than last time, and playing four games at once?!
That was something none of them had ever heard of. How did these weak Demi Gods manage to accomplish all of that?
Everyone present was extremely curious.
"Okay, your statement has been noted. Now, My L- COUGH... Vritra, do you disagree with any of those claims?" Evelyn asked, looking into his eyes. Her heart pounded, and she almost made a mistake.
She just wanted to keep staring at that dreamy face, too bad the circumstances didn't allow it.
"No, all of that did happen." Vritra said, not lying. After all, there was simply no point in doing so.
"Okay." Evelyn nodded, then asked, "Then is there a reason behind your actions?"

But before Vritra could speak, Petonil interrupted, "Miss Vespera, I don't believe there is any need to continue now that he has admitted to his crimes. Though I would like to add one more thing, this man is also related to the Divine! Those two women with him, Yasmine and Teresa, are Divine's sisters!"
This statement completely stunned the audience, the shock clearly visible on their faces.
The Divine, a name none of them could ever forget.
"That's a serious claim. Do you have anything to back it up?" Evelyn was annoyed that he had interrupted, but it was better to see all of the opponent's cards first.
"Of course, I wouldn't say something without proof." After speaking, Petonil turned back and glanced at the burly god who had both of his eyes missing.
Understanding his role, the eyeless god stood up and bowed respectfully toward Evelyn.

"He is the god whose eyes were stolen by the Divine, and everyone knows that Vritra possesses one of them. Now aren't you curious where the second eye is?" Petonil asked with a smug look, stroking his beard as confidence filled his face.
The god touched his face, pushing his forefinger and middle finger into his empty eye sockets.
He injected some sort of holy energy into them, causing bright light to shoot out from the empty sockets.
At the same time, a glow appeared on Vritra's forehead, where the Nether Eye was located.
Everyone gasped in shock.
So the claim was true. He really did possess one of the god's eyes, further supporting Petonil's accusation.
"..." Vritra, on the other hand, remained completely calm.
These people wanted him to receive the gravest punishment possible, so of course they were going to drag Divine into this.
"Now, what do you have to say for yourself?" Petonil grinned, turning and looking directly at Vritra for the first time.
'Yessss! That's it, Father, you've got him cornered! I knew you could do it! Hahaha, he is going to die!' Petophil was overjoyed, looking at his father with deep respect while even clapping.
"Huh? Are you asking me a question? Wow, you must be really famous. Not even asking the judge for permission, it's almost as if she's your subordinate." Vritra said, looking impressed.
"Uh..." Petonil froze.
He had developed the habit of controlling the flow of the courtroom like this.
But this was the first time the opposing party had called him out on it. Normally they would already be trembling in fear.

"Petonil, was it? Sir, should I vacate my seat so you can sit here comfortably? You must be thirsty. Should I personally bring you a drink and pour it for you?" Evelyn asked in an extremely polite tone.
But Petonil's face instantly turned bright red, burning with shame, and he didn't dare raise his head.
Her tone was polite, but every word felt like a sharp blade carving into his body.
"I- I am sorry." Despite all of his connections, he neither could nor dared offend such a powerful figure.
Even if she killed him here, Evelyn probably wouldn't receive any punishment.
"..." Petophil in the audience was dying from second-hand embarrassment as he looked at the surrounding people staring at him.
"I- I don't know him, I was just killing bugs earlier."
"M- Madam, may I ask him a few questions?" Petonil asked, even changing the way he addressed her, afraid of offending her again.
"No!" Evelyn answered without hesitation, leaving him completely baffled.
"So, Vritra, what do you have to say regarding both of those claims?" Evelyn asked, looking at her love.
No matter how hard she tried to remain impartial, there was still a faint trace of softness in both her tone and expression whenever she looked at him.
"Let's address his second claim first, Evelyn." Vritra spoke casually, and upon hearing that, everyone's ears perked up in shock.
All of them turned toward Evelyn, waiting for her to rebuke him.
He actually dared to address her by name so casually.
Surely he was finished... or so they hoped.
"Go ahead." Evelyn was euphoric inside. Just hearing her name spoken by him was enough to make her entire body melt.
Huhhhhhhhh?!!
No punishment?
How was this fair?
Everyone instantly felt indignant.
They didn't even dare look directly at Evelyn for more than a second.
"This eye? While exploring a dungeon, I simply found it lying around." Vritra said nonchalantly, almost giving the eyeless god a heart attack.
Those were his eyes, priceless treasures whose value couldn't even be estimated, and what?
He had just found them lying around?
The burly god felt utterly insulted and enraged.
His eyes weren't trash that someone could simply stumble across on the roadside.
The lie couldn't have been any more obvious.
That bastard was definitely going to die.

"Okay, that is possible. Therefore, one of Petonil's claims has been dismissed. Since you mentioned the Divine, if you fail to prove that accusation, you will receive a punishment even worse than your son." Evelyn spoke, pointing toward Petophil seated among the audience.
"So, you really are his son? How dare a shrimp lie! You're dead the moment we leave this place!"
"Pfft! Did he just disown his father to save face? Hahaha! How about I become your daddy instead? Is your mother single?"
The people surrounding Petophil instantly burst into laughter and began mocking him.

'Tsk... this is even worse than I expected. I thought she would at least be a little fair since I'm handling the case now, but she really does whatever she pleases.' Petonil, as an experienced lawyer, didn't lose his composure.
He calmly said, "But, Madam, is there any proof that he found it inside a dungeon?"

"Do you have any proof that Divine gave it to me? Haven't you ever heard of finders keepers? He might have simply thrown it away, so if I happen to find one, am I supposed to just leave it there?" Vritra said mockingly.
"You're even worse than your son." Vritra added, shaking his head.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 852 The Pro Lawyer
paragraphs: By Vritra's words, Petonil was suddenly stunned into silence.
He really couldn't prove that the eye had been given by the Divine himself.
But still, that wasn't all.
"Then how do you explain having Divine's abilities? Did you find those lying around too?" As he spoke, Petonil squeezed a ball-like object.
A large screen appeared, showing Vritra using different abilities like Forbid and the Dimensional Book.
Most of those abilities were clearly associated with the Divine.
"Of course, I found those in a dungeon too. How am I supposed to know whether they belonged to the Divine or not?" Vritra said, then turned to Evelyn and asked, "Right, Miss Judge?"
"Certainly. I myself have found a few of those abilities. He had spread them around the universe, anyone could have found them."
After speaking, Evelyn muttered, "Forbid."
Instantly, almost everyone in the court froze except Vritra and his family.
Petonil: "..."
How was he supposed to fight against both the judge and this devious Vritra? They were outright dismissing everything.
"What about his sisters?!" Petonil shouted, growing frustrated.
"Oh? Sisters?" Vritra looked at the idiot before turning back and asking,
"Wifey, Tess, do either of you have a brother named Divine?"
"What brother? I was the only child in my dragon family." Yasmine replied confidently.
"I did have a brother, but he was human and was killed by you, husband. I don't know any Divine." Teresa shrugged innocently.
Vritra looked back at Petonil with a faint smile.
Without saying a word, his expression alone said everything.
Petonil shouted, "They were his sisters in their previous lives!"
Vritra immediately turned to him and replied in the same loud tone, turning it into a heated argument.
"You were a mosquito in your previous life. Should I crush you?

What do their previous lives have to do with this one? Isn't that the whole purpose of reincarnation? To have a completely new beginning, to leave everything behind and become an entirely different being? And how do you even know they were Divine's sisters? Why should they be associated with him?"
"Of course I know! I was told by the gods. They had already confirmed it. And I can also guarantee that Divine is still connected to them and-"
But Vritra immediately cut him off.
"You just keep slandering us! How can you prove Divine is still around his sisters, assuming they even are his sisters as you claim?!"
The discussion became so rapid that the people in the audience held their breath.
It was as if a battle had erupted inside the courtroom.
"Divine is still-"
"How?!"
"The gods told-"
"How do they know?! Are the gods to be believed without proof? Then what's even the point of this court? Evelyn, why don't you just give them your seat? It seems their words carry more weight."
"How dare you speak to her like that?! Of course there is enough proof-"
"What is the proof?!" Vritra interrupted again, his voice growing louder with every sentence.
His wives were genuinely surprised.
"Several times, my clients sent people to bring the Divine's sisters over, but only because of Divine did they fail-"
The words had barely left Petonil's mouth when he immediately regretted them.
"You stupid bastard!" the gods behind him cursed inwardly, yet remained seated.
Vritra's fierce expression immediately turned into a smile as he looked at Evelyn and said,
"Just as you heard, the gods have been sending powerful Demi Gods to cause trouble for my family... for my wives. We nearly lost our lives several times because of them."
For the first time, Petonil truly grew nervous.
How had Vritra managed to do that?
During that heated exchange, he had completely controlled the direction of the discussion and tricked him into admitting something he was never supposed to reveal.
But Vritra continued relentlessly, having found an opening and intending to exploit it completely.
"Not only that, they even established an organization called Divine Kage to harass us, even abusing the gods' punishment against me for absolutely no reason on more than one occasion."
"That is a lie!" the Sun God sprang to his feet.
But Vritra merely looked back at him with contempt.
"Did someone ask you to speak? Stay seated and be a good boy."
Burning with shame and fury, the Sun God had no choice but to sit back down.
When had he ever suffered such humiliation?
He was the most respected among the ten gods and even among the vast majority of gods throughout the universe.
No one had ever dared look down on him.
Yet this Vritra...
He was utterly ruthless.
"And not long ago, a member of Divine Kage called Number Zero met with one of the gods. They even had a conversation, and this is what happened..."
Then Vritra played the recording of Number Zero meeting one of the gods.
["I already know everything you have said, and quite a few have already gone to take care of him. But we won't underestimate him anymore."]
["We have a reason to eliminate him. Still, we can't directly intervene, so I will share a bit of my power with you, enough to kill any Demi God below Level 6."] the god said.
As everyone watched the recording, they were stunned yet again.
But the ones who were truly shocked were none other than the gods and Petonil.
'How did he obtain this? And he shouldn't even know Number Zero's identity.' the god thought, unable to utter a single word.
Directly interfering with a mortal like that was a grave crime for a god, especially without any legitimate reason.
"I- It's fake! It has to be fake! Otherwise, with his strength, how could he possibly record something like this without alerting a god?" Petonil hurriedly argued.
"Heh, sure. Believe whatever you want. Do you think this recording treasure can be forged?"
He held up a strange golden box specifically used for recordings.
Even the gods themselves were incapable of forging its recordings.
Of course, it had been given to him by Evelyn through Divine. Vritra had noticed Number Zero back then, but Divine had suggested a plan.
Which was why Vritra hadn't bothered stopping him and simply allowed him to meet the gods.
"H- How do you even possess that?!" Petonil gulped.
This guy had come completely prepared.
The harder he pushed, the deeper they all sank.
For the first time, he truly sympathized with his son.

"Why should I tell you that? Anyway, all the evidence is right before everyone. I believe everything is already clear." Vritra said before turning toward Evelyn and adding, "Even now, you can check. There should be a large number of Demi Gods heading over to kill me."
The moment he finished speaking, the man in black confirmed it.
There really were numerous Demi Gods, ranging from Level 5 to Level 10, surrounding Planet Zoratian.
None of them could enter.
And every single one of them had come to kill Vritra and his family.

"Hmm. As seen from the recording, and from the fact that all of Petonil's claims have turned out to be nothing more than slander, it is clear that the gods deliberately went out of their way to kill Vritra and his family by abusing their power and authority, even dispatching countless Demi Gods.
It is therefore evident that you are the ones at fault and have wrongfully abused your authority, violating Rule 403 of Clause 69, Rule 1 of Clause 7... of the Gods' Edict!"
Evelyn listed a long series of laws they had violated.
Even Petonil became lost halfway through.
'Whoa...'
Even Vritra was impressed.
She looked incredibly intelligent and authoritative.
"The punishment for those violations will be carried out later. Do you have anything further to add?" Evelyn asked, turning toward Petonil.
"Er..." Petonil stared blankly, his throat suddenly dry.
He hurriedly grabbed a glass of water and emptied it in one gulp.
It wasn't enough.
So he drank several more.
"COUGH... E- Even setting the Divine matter aside, how do they explain all the destruction they caused? The games they ruined?" Petonil said.
That had been the main accusation from the beginning.
Vritra immediately put on a pitiful expression.

"What choice did I have? The gods wanted to kill me. Everyone on Planet Zoratian would have died... my wives, my poor parents... how could I possibly allow that to happen? Left with no other option, I had no choice but to come here.

Shouldn't the gods be held responsible for the chaos within the games? Or simply because they are powerful, are they allowed to do whatever they please while we, the weak, are forced to bear responsibility even for things we never intended? Is that all the law amounts to?
Is there no justice in this world? Do you think I would willingly compete against Level 5 and Level 6 Demi Gods if I had any other choice?"
Vritra spoke everything in one breath, looking deeply aggrieved.
"..." Even Petonil stared at Vritra with his mouth hanging open.
The previous time, he had watched the recording of his son arguing against Vritra.
Back then, he had believed Petophil only lost because Evelyn had sided with Vritra.
Although she had helped him a little this time as well...
It was mainly Vritra who had carried the entire hearing.
He had completely dominated the courtroom.
Had this guy really become such an incredible lawyer after experiencing just one trial?
From being the accused, he had somehow turned himself into the victim, while making the gods look even guiltier than everything they had accused him of.

"S- Still... you could have accomplished the same thing using only one game. Why did you merge four games together?" Petonil asked, completely at a loss for words and unable to think of anything else.
"Hah. That was also the gods' fault." Vritra said, and continued...

"You stupid bastard!" the gods behind him cursed inwardly, yet remained seated.
Vritra's fierce expression immediately turned into a smile as he looked at Evelyn and said,
"Just as you heard, the gods have been sending powerful Demi Gods to cause trouble for my family... for my wives.
We nearly lost our lives several times because of them."
For the first time, Petonil truly grew nervous.
How had Vritra managed to do that?
During that heated exchange, he had completely controlled the direction of the discussion and tricked him into admitting something he was never supposed to reveal.
But Vritra continued relentlessly, having found an opening and intending to exploit it completely.
"Not only that, they even established an organization called Divine Kage to harass us, even abusing the gods' punishment against me for absolutely no reason on more than one occasion."
"That is a lie!" the Sun God sprang to his feet.
But Vritra merely looked back at him with contempt.
"Did someone ask you to speak?
Stay seated and be a good boy."
Burning with shame and fury, the Sun God had no choice but to sit back down.
When had he ever suffered such humiliation?
He was the most respected among the ten gods and even among the vast majority of gods throughout the universe.
No one had ever dared look down on him.
Yet this Vritra...
He was utterly ruthless.
"And not long ago, a member of Divine Kage called Number Zero met with one of the gods.
They even had a conversation, and this is what happened..."
Then Vritra played the recording of Number Zero meeting one of the gods.
["I already know everything you have said, and quite a few have already gone to take care of him.
But we won't underestimate him anymore."]
["We have a reason to eliminate him.
Still, we can't directly intervene, so I will share a bit of my power with you, enough to kill any Demi God below Level 6."] the god said.
As everyone watched the recording, they were stunned yet again.
But the ones who were truly shocked were none other than the gods and Petonil.
'How did he obtain this?
And he shouldn't even know Number Zero's identity.' the god thought, unable to utter a single word.
Directly interfering with a mortal like that was a grave crime for a god, especially without any legitimate reason.
"I- It's fake!
It has to be fake!
Otherwise, with his strength, how could he possibly record something like this without alerting a god?" Petonil hurriedly argued.
"Heh, sure.
Believe whatever you want.
Do you think this recording treasure can be forged?"
He held up a strange golden box specifically used for recordings.
Even the gods themselves were incapable of forging its recordings.
Of course, it had been given to him by Evelyn through Divine.
Vritra had noticed Number Zero back then, but Divine had suggested a plan.
Which was why Vritra hadn't bothered stopping him and simply allowed him to meet the gods.
"H- How do you even possess that?!" Petonil gulped.
This guy had come completely prepared.
The harder he pushed, the deeper they all sank.
For the first time, he truly sympathized with his son.
"Why should I tell you that?
Anyway, all the evidence is right before everyone.
I believe everything is already clear." Vritra said before turning toward Evelyn and adding, "Even now, you can check.
There should be a large number of Demi Gods heading over to kill me."
The moment he finished speaking, the man in black confirmed it.
There really were numerous Demi Gods, ranging from Level 5 to Level 10, surrounding Planet Zoratian.
None of them could enter.
And every single one of them had come to kill Vritra and his family.
"Hmm.

As seen from the recording, and from the fact that all of Petonil's claims have turned out to be nothing more than slander, it is clear that the gods deliberately went out of their way to kill Vritra and his family by abusing their power and authority, even dispatching countless Demi Gods.
It is therefore evident that you are the ones at fault and have wrongfully abused your authority, violating Rule 403 of Clause 69, Rule 1 of Clause 7... of the Gods' Edict!"
Evelyn listed a long series of laws they had violated.
Even Petonil became lost halfway through.
'Whoa...'
Even Vritra was impressed.
She looked incredibly intelligent and authoritative.
"The punishment for those violations will be carried out later.
Do you have anything further to add?" Evelyn asked, turning toward Petonil.
"Er..." Petonil stared blankly, his throat suddenly dry.
He hurriedly grabbed a glass of water and emptied it in one gulp.
It wasn't enough.
So he drank several more.
"COUGH...
E- Even setting the Divine matter aside, how do they explain all the destruction they caused?
The games they ruined?" Petonil said.
That had been the main accusation from the beginning.
Vritra immediately put on a pitiful expression.
"What choice did I have?
The gods wanted to kill me.
Everyone on Planet Zoratian would have died... my wives, my poor parents... how could I possibly allow that to happen?
Left with no other option, I had no choice but to come here.
Shouldn't the gods be held responsible for the chaos within the games?
Or simply because they are powerful, are they allowed to do whatever they please while we, the weak, are forced to bear responsibility even for things we never intended?
Is that all the law amounts to?
Is there no justice in this world?
Do you think I would willingly compete against Level 5 and Level 6 Demi Gods if I had any other choice?"
Vritra spoke everything in one breath, looking deeply aggrieved.
"..." Even Petonil stared at Vritra with his mouth hanging open.
The previous time, he had watched the recording of his son arguing against Vritra.
Back then, he had believed Petophil only lost because Evelyn had sided with Vritra.
Although she had helped him a little this time as well...
It was mainly Vritra who had carried the entire hearing.
He had completely dominated the courtroom.
Had this guy really become such an incredible lawyer after experiencing just one trial?
From being the accused, he had somehow turned himself into the victim, while making the gods look even guiltier than everything they had accused him of.
"S- Still... you could have accomplished the same thing using only one game.
Why did you merge four games together?" Petonil asked, completely at a loss for words and unable to think of anything else.
"Hah.
That was also the gods' fault." Vritra said, and continued...
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 853 The Powerful Backup
paragraphs: "Hah. That was also the gods' fault." Vritra said, then continued with a shrug, "I only wanted to enter the game so they would stop trying to kill me and my family, but they caused an accident and all of this happened."
Petonil was utterly speechless. What sort of excuse was that even?
It was like a pitiful thief saying, I only went to steal because I was poor, but the owner came back at the wrong time. So it was his fault that I killed him, not mine.

"That makes no sense. Even if there was a reason like that behind it, it doesn't change the fact that you caused heavy losses for the higher beings and the gods, so you will have to take responsibility for it." Petonil argued.

"Fine. If trying to protect my family from those criminals is a crime, then I am a criminal. If the law only supports the powerful and suppresses the weak, then I deserve punishment. Go ahead and give me the harshest punishment." Vritra said, turning his gaze away, his voice filled with pain.
"Ha." Petonil clicked his tongue at the acting, but he wasn't someone who would fall for it.

"So you have just admitted to your crimes. Therefore, ma'am, I request that you give him the harshest punishment. Even if the motives behind his actions were good, a crime is still a crime, and he should be punished so-"
"So that next time, the weak won't dare raise their voices against the powerful even when they are harassed to death?" Vritra completed the sentence in a mocking tone.
"Enough. I have heard everything, and I know who is at fault. I will declare my judgment in five minutes." Evelyn announced before going over everything that had been said throughout the hearing.
Heh. I wasn't able to get you punished for your association with Divine. That's unfortunate, but you'll still receive a heavy punishment for your crimes. Petonil thought.
He didn't believe that Evelyn, as a higher being, would completely throw away her dignity and sense of justice.
And make such a one-sided decision. This time was different from the last.
If she did that, then Petonil would simply take the matter to someone even higher.
Complete silence filled the once-chaotic courtroom for several minutes.
Vritra and Petonil both took their seats, waiting patiently.
Petophil, who had nearly been beaten up by the crowd, had moved to the very back and was praying for his father's success.
Meanwhile, his father was reassuring the gods that, unlike before, both sides would receive punishment this time.
Soon, Evelyn looked up, and most people tensed, eager to hear the verdict.
"Based on the facts, evidence, and statements presented, I hereby declare my judgment..." She paused briefly before announcing,

"For failing to properly manage games of such a high level and for wrongfully abusing their authority, the ten gods shall each be punished with ninety-nine days in the lowest level of Hell Prison and a deduction of one-quarter of their total mana, which shall be transferred to Vritra's group as compensation, along with an evolution to Level 7.
Furthermore, the gods are prohibited from directly or indirectly interfering with their lives, and as additional compensation, they shall surrender the fourth-ranked Mythic Halo, The Sun."
As those words echoed throughout the courtroom, everyone was stunned.
The gods and Petonil even more so.
Complete silence remained until Petonil suddenly sprang to his feet, unable to accept such terms.
This was complete nonsense.
It was completely one-sided and made absolutely no sense.
Gritting his teeth, he waited, wondering whether Vritra's group would receive an equally severe punishment, or whether he would have to use his connections.

"As for the crimes committed by Vritra and his family, considering the severity of their actions, they shall not only leave Planet Zoratian, but each of them shall also spend six months in Hell Prison."
Once again, everyone was shocked.
This time, it was Vritra's turn.
He looked at Evelyn quizzically, wondering what this was about.
Had she been forced to hand down such a heavy punishment?
The gods had such ugly expressions over merely ninety-nine days in Hell Prison, yet they were being sentenced to over one hundred and eighty days?
Wasn't she supposed to be on his side?
What was happening?
Still, Vritra said nothing.
There had to be a reason.
He had begun to trust her.
"Does either side have any objections to my judgment?" Evelyn asked calmly.
"No, I don't." Vritra replied with a nod.
"Y-Yes, we do, ma'am." Petonil spoke quickly.
Although he was greatly surprised and satisfied by Vritra's punishment.
Six months in Hell Prison?
Could they even survive that long?
It was essentially a death sentence for the entire family.
He had never imagined Evelyn would actually go this far.
He had been convinced she would either give them no punishment at all or merely a light sentence.
Yet now, it was unbelievably severe.
"You may speak." Evelyn said.
"I and the gods have no objections to the punishment you have given them. It is quite appropriate considering their crimes." Petonil began calmly.
Only a minute ago he had nearly exploded in anger.
But now he looked at Vritra with a gloating expression, his eyes saying,
You're dead!
"But the punishment imposed upon the gods... isn't that excessive? Giving away twenty-five percent of their strength? And even the fourth-ranked Mythic Halo?
Even if the gods were at fault and attempted to harm them, they are perfectly fine now.
A lighter compensation should be more than enough. Besides, these people won't even get the chance to use any of it." Petonil spoke confidently and calmly.
"Oh, wait. I forgot to add something." Evelyn suddenly said.
Hoo... Even higher beings make mistakes? Anyway, now the gods will finally be satisfied. This is exactly why I am one of the best lawyers in the universe. Petonil thought, looking back with a smile.
Certain that Evelyn was about to reduce the compensation.
"Petonil, you too are sentenced to ninety-nine days in Hell Prison, and after your release, you shall receive one hundred and eleven lashes at the Altar."
"Oh, thank you fo-"
Petonil stopped halfway through his sentence as his eyes widened in horror.
Why was the lawyer receiving such a heavy punishment too?
"This is bullshit! Why am I receiving such a severe punishment?! And you need to change the gods' punishment too!!"
Now Petonil completely lost control.
He wanted to restrain himself.
After all, a higher being was sitting before him.
But every ounce of his pent-up rage exploded out at once.
"You think you can do whatever you want? I have powerful connections! If I file even a single complaint against you, the entire Vespera Family will be in trouble!
You've been taking his side from the very beginning, making a mockery of the law!
This is the World Court, not your family estate where you can do whatever you please! You'd better change the judgment, or the consequences won't be pleasant!"
The moment those words left his mouth, Petonil already began regretting them.
But now that he had said them...
There was no taking them back.
He might only be a god, but that didn't mean she could simply bully him.
"Is that so?" Evelyn, on the other hand, remained perfectly calm.
She leaned forward, resting her chin upon her hand before saying,
"Then go ahead and call your backup. Otherwise, I'll chop both your hands off in ten minutes."
Petonil's heart pounded with fear.
He had truly made a mistake.
His anger had mainly been directed at Vritra.
Yet he had accidentally vented it all at Evelyn instead.
Ugh... How did this happen? How did I lose my composure?
Seeing her calm expression, Petonil knew she was completely serious.
"I-I will."
He spoke with trembling hands as he hurriedly pulled out several different communication artifacts.
He attempted to contact numerous higher beings and other influential figures whose legal cases he had handled in the past.
He truly, truly regretted what he had just said.
Vritra merely shook his head before walking back to his seat, curious to see how everything would unfold.
Taking out several communication devices, Petonil contacted one influential figure after another.
Begging them to come and help him.
At first, he mentioned Evelyn's name while speaking to a powerful higher being.
The call was instantly disconnected.
Then he was blocked forever.
Stunned and frightened, he stopped mentioning Evelyn's name altogether, merely urging them to come quickly and help resolve his problem.
After five minutes, having contacted more than ten people, six of them finally agreed to come.
Petonil stood there with his back straight.
Outwardly confident.
Inwardly consumed by fear.
The next five minutes became the longest five minutes of his entire life as every eye in the silent courtroom remained fixed upon him.
Soon afterward, several portals opened.
Exactly six people stepped through.
Five were higher beings, while one was an Asura, who arrived first.
Evelyn merely glanced at them without the slightest change in her expression.
"Hoho! What sort of trouble has our capable lawyer gotten himself into that he had to call me here?" the Asura laughed loudly, his voice filled with arrogance.
His upper body was bare, as Asuras loved showing off their muscles.
"H-Help me! Miss Vespera, she is-" Petonil finally regained some courage and hurriedly spoke.
"What?! You have a dispute with Miss Vespera?" the Asura asked.
The others had yet to fully emerge from their portals.
They knew nothing about what had happened.
"Y-Yes! She has wrongfully punished me! Her judgment is completely unfair! Please, for old times' sake and because I once helped you, assist me with-"
Before he could finish speaking, the Asura landed beside him.
Looking at him with pitiful eyes, he gently patted Petonil's shoulder and kindly muttered,
"You were a good man. As for that favor... I'll take good care of your wife after you're gone."
Petonil: "..."
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 854 The Rewards and Punishments
paragraphs: Petonil didn't know what to say as the Asura patted his shoulder, giving him a look of pity.
After speaking, the Asura turned and bowed deeply to Evelyn.
"Please forgive me, Miss Vespera. I didn't know this fool had offended you, or I would have never come here. As an apology, how about I cut off his head?" the Asura asked, his voice very docile.
'W- What the fuck?! I called you for help, and you want to take my wife and cut my head off?!' Petonil was going crazy.
"There is no need for that."
Evelyn had just finished speaking when the remaining five portals finally opened, and five higher beings walked out.
"Oh, he called you guys too? Haha, I wonder what Advocate Petonil has done to need all of our help." the oldest among the five higher beings spoke, his hands clasped behind his back.
Finally, they scanned the courtroom and saw Evelyn.
Quickly, all five of them landed and bowed even more deeply toward her.
"Miss Vespera, we greet you. Sorry for causing this sudden disturbance. Please tell us your orders, and we will leave immediately if you wish."
They all looked like servants before her, surprise and awkwardness evident on their faces.
"Uh... I was the one who called you all here." Petonil really didn't know what to say.
"Oh, Petonil, wait a minute. We first need Miss Vespera's permission before helping you." the oldest said.
Petonil's lips stretched into a thin line.
He was done for.
His backup was made up of his enemy's servants?
Did he still have a chance?
He was finished.
Petonil trembled.
Why?
Why did he have to do that?
"Sure, you can help him with whatever." Evelyn shrugged.
"Thank you."
After bowing, they turned to Petonil and asked,
"So, what help do you need?"
"Uh... I need you to help me persuade Miss Vespera-"
Before he had even finished speaking, the five men immediately understood that his dispute was with Evelyn.
Every single one of them looked at him with pity.
One by one, they patted his shoulder.
Then they bowed toward Evelyn, asking for her forgiveness just like the Asura had done earlier while denying having any relationship with that fool.
Soon, all six of them were gone.
They fled so quickly that it looked as though Petonil was carrying some deadly plague.
And just like that... ten minutes passed.
SLASH
With just a thought from Evelyn, a blade of mental energy materialized, even becoming completely solid.
It shot through the air, passed by Petonil, and vanished just as smoothly.
Everything happened in an instant.
A moment later, both of Petonil's arms fell to the ground with faint thuds, followed by two sprays of blood shooting into the air.
"AHHHHHH! AHHHHHHHH!!"
"And hereby, I declare that this case has ended."
"AHHHHH! AHHHHHH!!"
"As neither side has any further objections to my judgment, we shall now proceed with the punishments and compensations."
"AHHH! AHHH!!"
"Tch. Silence him."
Hearing the annoyance in Evelyn's voice, the gods quickly stuffed a piece of cloth into Petonil's mouth and dragged him away.
Leaving behind a long trail of blood.
The gods were just as furious and helpless as Petonil.
Of course they didn't agree with their punishment.
Were they really supposed to hand over twenty-five percent of their mana?
That was nearly a quarter of the strength they had accumulated ever since becoming gods.
They had been gods for an unimaginably long time, and twenty-five percent amounted to an enormous loss.
Not to mention giving away a Mythic Halo.
That was a supreme treasure, something capable of continuously growing stronger.
Take the First Mythic Halo for example.
It was already so powerful that even the higher beings were wary of it.
Divine had obtained it, and that Mythic Halo was one of the main reasons everyone had united to get rid of him.
At first, those proud higher beings hadn't taken him seriously.
But after witnessing his abilities, his monstrous growth rate, and the way he perfectly wielded the Creation Mythic Halo...
All of them had no choice but to unite, using every method they could think of before finally managing to subdue him.
Although Divine wasn't killed and was merely sealed away, one could easily understand just how precious these Mythic Halos truly were.
Now some might wonder, why don't the higher beings simply take them for themselves?
Because all of the Mythic Halos are currently still in their nurturing stage.
Once they mature enough, the higher beings will reclaim them.
That was why they were so unwilling to part with such a powerful Mythic Halo.
After all, The Sun had belonged to the Sun God.
This compensation was simply too severe.
But they had no choice.
Having announced her judgment, Evelyn stood up and, after glancing at Vritra one last time with longing in her eyes, turned and walked away.
Vritra watched Evelyn until she disappeared from sight before finally turning toward the gods.
"I remember someone saying something earlier... about me begging or something. So, how does it feel now?" he asked.

"Hah, don't celebrate too early. We may have suffered a loss, but your punishment... don't think you'll make it out alive. Six months in Hell Prison is a pure death sentence. You won't get to use any of those rewards anyway." the burly god retorted.
At least that fact made them feel slightly better.
Their punishment was terrible.
But at least they would survive.
"Heh. About that... we'll just have to wait and see. Bye-bye."
Right after speaking, they all disappeared.
Vritra and the others found themselves in a vast, dark space.
For now, they were being sent back to Planet Zoratian.
Then, according to the punishment, they would have to leave that planet forever.
Vritra looked around.
Now only he and his family remained.
"Honey, what was that punishment about?" Vanessa asked, wondering whether he knew anything.
"I... don't know either, but I think Divine certainly knows something about it." Vritra sighed.

Thanks for reading...

After speaking, the Asura turned and bowed deeply to Evelyn.
"Please forgive me, Miss Vespera.
I didn't know this fool had offended you, or I would have never come here.
As an apology, how about I cut off his head?" the Asura asked, his voice very docile.
'W- What the fuck?!
I called you for help, and you want to take my wife and cut my head off?!' Petonil was going crazy.
"There is no need for that."
Evelyn had just finished speaking when the remaining five portals finally opened, and five higher beings walked out.
"Oh, he called you guys too?
Haha, I wonder what Advocate Petonil has done to need all of our help." the oldest among the five higher beings spoke, his hands clasped behind his back.
Finally, they scanned the courtroom and saw Evelyn.
Quickly, all five of them landed and bowed even more deeply toward her.
"Miss Vespera, we greet you.
Sorry for causing this sudden disturbance.
Please tell us your orders, and we will leave immediately if you wish."
They all looked like servants before her, surprise and awkwardness evident on their faces.
I was the one who called you all here." Petonil really didn't know what to say.
"Oh, Petonil, wait a minute.
We first need Miss Vespera's permission before helping you." the oldest said.
Petonil's lips stretched into a thin line.
He was done for.
His backup was made up of his enemy's servants?
Did he still have a chance?
He was finished.
Petonil trembled.
Why?
Why did he have to do that?
"Sure, you can help him with whatever." Evelyn shrugged.
"Thank you."
After bowing, they turned to Petonil and asked,
"So, what help do you need?"
I need you to help me persuade Miss Vespera-"
Before he had even finished speaking, the five men immediately understood that his dispute was with Evelyn.
Every single one of them looked at him with pity.
One by one, they patted his shoulder.
Then they bowed toward Evelyn, asking for her forgiveness just like the Asura had done earlier while denying having any relationship with that fool.
Soon, all six of them were gone.
They fled so quickly that it looked as though Petonil was carrying some deadly plague.
And just like that... ten minutes passed.
SLASH
With just a thought from Evelyn, a blade of mental energy materialized, even becoming completely solid.
It shot through the air, passed by Petonil, and vanished just as smoothly.
Everything happened in an instant.
A moment later, both of Petonil's arms fell to the ground with faint thuds, followed by two sprays of blood shooting into the air.
"AHHHHHH!
AHHHHHHHH!!"
"And hereby, I declare that this case has ended."
"AHHHHH!
AHHHHHH!!"
"As neither side has any further objections to my judgment, we shall now proceed with the punishments and compensations."
"AHHH!
AHHH!!"
"Tch.

Hearing the annoyance in Evelyn's voice, the gods quickly stuffed a piece of cloth into Petonil's mouth and dragged him away.
Leaving behind a long trail of blood.
The gods were just as furious and helpless as Petonil.
Of course they didn't agree with their punishment.
Were they really supposed to hand over twenty-five percent of their mana?
That was nearly a quarter of the strength they had accumulated ever since becoming gods.
They had been gods for an unimaginably long time, and twenty-five percent amounted to an enormous loss.
Not to mention giving away a Mythic Halo.
That was a supreme treasure, something capable of continuously growing stronger.
Take the First Mythic Halo for example.
It was already so powerful that even the higher beings were wary of it.

At first, those proud higher beings hadn't taken him seriously.

chapters.title: Chapter 855 The Home
paragraphs: Inside his office, Gunter was looking through the documents of all the business the Yate family had done over the previous month, calculating the profits when he suddenly heard a wild roar along with a strange scream, as if some animal was being beaten.
Frowning, he quickly ran out of the office.
Since the whole planet had been cleared of the demons, there hadn't been another attack.
Everyone on the planet was living such happy lives. No children were being kidnapped or turned into orphans.
No more endless slaughters of poor villagers—it was truly a peaceful time.
Even crime had become extremely rare.
So, Gunter couldn't understand who could be causing such a disturbance as he rushed outside.
"UWAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!"
The moment he stepped out, he saw a familiar bald guy sitting on top of a bull that was charging at full speed.
Tears were streaming down the man's face as he desperately clung onto the bull.
"Shitless? He's back?!" After a moment of shock, Gunter quickly came back to his senses.
"Bullo, wait!" Shouting, Gunter was about to run over and help Shitless, but Bullo suddenly came to a stop.
The pitiful guy on its back was thrown forward, landing face-first before skidding several metres.
Only then did he finally come to a stop right in front of Gunter.
"A- Are you okay?" Gunter quickly helped Shitless up. His face was a little red, but fortunately he wasn't injured.
"Ugh... Yes, I'm fine. I'm used to it by now." Shitless grumbled while rubbing his forehead.
Thankfully, his body had become much stronger, or his skin would've peeled off. After all, the ground was hard.
"How come you're back so quickly this time? Where are the others?" Gunter asked, unable to hide the excitement in his voice.
He had thought they would all be gone for several months, so their sudden return made him very happy.
Shitless suddenly thought of something, then looked at Gunter, his expression slowly turning sorrowful.
Then he silently shook his head.
Gunter's heart skipped a beat.
He nearly stumbled backward, his eyes widening.
Panic struck him as he grabbed onto Shitless for support before asking again,
"W- What happened? They're fine, right?! P- Please tell me they're fine..." Gunter looked on the verge of breaking down.
How could he even imagine losing everyone all at once?
His son...
His daughters-in-law...
Even his grandchild.
This had to be a lie.
Seeing Gunter, who looked as though he had aged several years in an instant and lost all the strength in his body, Shitless suddenly felt guilty.
Clearing his throat, he hurriedly said,
"They're all fine! I just came ahead, so I meant... I don't know where they are."
'I went too far... ugh, I hope Pitiful One didn't notice.' Shitless prayed.
"..." Gunter's lips stretched into a thin line as he looked at Shitless as if saying,
"Are you seriously making jokes like this?"
Gunter: (ಠ_ಠ)
Before Gunter had a chance to say anything further, he heard several footsteps along with the voices of multiple people.
"Art?!" Gunter turned around, and sure enough, it was them.
He quickly counted everyone.
Thankfully, no one was missing.
Even that thief friend was present.
He shot Shitless a glare, only to find him looking up at the stars in broad daylight while whistling.
"Art!"
Without hesitation, Gunter rushed forward and pulled Vritra into a hug, immensely relieved that they had all returned safely.
Especially after that little prank.
"We're back." Vritra spoke with a faint smile.
Hearing the commotion, the now perfectly healthy Ava walked out of her room to see what had happened.
The moment she saw the group, she forgot everything else.
It was as though the world had stopped existing at that very moment.
Before her mind could even process it, her feet had already begun moving, rushing toward Vritra.
"My Art, you're finally back. I missed you so much."
She hugged him as well, gently caressing his head.
Then she hugged each of her daughters-in-law one by one, overjoyed to see them all return safely.
"Are you all fine?" she asked before walking over to Yasmine.
"Yes, we're all perfectly fine and finished our task." Vritra replied.
It felt really nice to return here.
This place had such a homely feeling, especially knowing these two people had been waiting for all of them.
"Yes, I am. Your son took such good care of me after all." Yasmine said with a beautiful smile.
"Let's go inside and talk. I'll have the cooks prepare food for all of us." Ava said, taking Yasmine's hand as they walked into the palace.
Soon the group was seated inside a large hall.
Light snacks and drinks were served first while the main dishes were being prepared.
Gunter was equally excited to hear everything they had gone through.
Although he could never become a demi-god himself, he wanted to know everything about their adventures.
He was like a child, eagerly waiting to hear the entire story.
"This time you entered another game? What was it like?" Gunter asked.
"Dear, I'm sure that can wait. They must be hungry." Ava said, shaking her head at her husband.
"Haa... fine. Here, son, eat this." Gunter sighed.
His wife's words were law after all.
So he picked up the snacks and began passing them around so everyone could finish eating sooner.
"It's fine. The story this time isn't that long. We finished rather quickly." Onest said while munching on a spicy chip.
"Yes, but what a mess it was. Onest even died." Shitless suddenly added.
Gunter and Ava both looked at Onest before slowly turning back toward Shitless.
The expressions on both of their faces looked exactly the same.
Gunter and Ava: (눈_눈)
"Did you develop some strange new fetish during this game? Why do you keep trying to declare everyone dead?" Gunter asked.
Before and now, Shitless had done it again.
"Er..." Shitless was at a loss for words.
Earlier it had been a joke.
This time, however, it was actually true.
"What happened earlier?" Onest asked.
They hadn't been paying attention.
"Before I asked him about you all, and he—"
Gunter had just begun speaking when Shitless quickly cut him off, immediately seeking help from the only person with even higher authority.
"A- Aunty, Uncle keeps talking. He won't let me eat." Shitless complained.
"Dear, I told you, the stories can wait. Whatever happened before, it's fine." Ava said, seeing right through Shitless's little scheme.
She wondered why her husband was acting so childishly.
There was no need to tell everyone something Shitless didn't want revealed.
"..." Gunter fell silent.
Looking at the smug expression on Shitless's face, he silently decided to take revenge later.
They continued eating and chatting.
Most of the conversation consisted of Vritra and the others asking about everything that had happened on the planet.
Thankfully, there hadn't been any major problems so far.
It seemed the Divine Kage had completely disappeared from the planet.
Normally, gods couldn't create organizations like that on a planet, but they had managed to do it discreetly by keeping everyone hidden.
"So although there have been a few minor thefts, nothing major has happened, and the thieves are caught quickly." Gunter said.
"That's great."
"There haven't been any signs of the demons, have there?" Yennefer asked.
She hated even hearing the word demon.
Though Vritra was naturally an exception.
Even if he really were a demon, she would never hate him.
"No. The demons truly seem to have disappeared. The land has been very peaceful." Gunter replied.
By then, various hot dishes had already been served before the group.
Finally, while eating kebabs and the other dishes, Vritra and the others began telling Gunter about their adventure.
Although it had been short, it was packed with twists and dangers.
In fact, it had been far more dangerous than the previous game.
Except for the Level 3 demi-gods, everyone else had been powerful enough to kill them all.
So it was truly shocking that they had actually won.
"Woah... Level 5 and Level 6?! Those demi-gods must have been incredibly powerful. Did you fight them too?" Gunter asked after hearing about the four games.
"Not directly, at least. There was no way we could defeat them in a direct fight." Fiona replied before dramatically explaining how they had killed the two Level 6 demi-gods.
She described everything that had happened, including the moment they had nearly been caught because of a tiny mistake.
Gunter imagined every scene so vividly that Vritra decided to make it even more realistic.
Using Misty Essence, he created an illusion that replayed various parts of the game directly from his memories.
Now even Ava became completely absorbed.
For her, however, it felt like watching a horror movie.
She was genuinely terrified.
Whenever Vritra or the others were placed in danger, her heart nearly jumped out of her chest.
Meanwhile, Gunter's blood was boiling with excitement.
He almost wanted to jump into the illusion and play the game himself.
The food was finished, yet everyone remained seated, watching the ultra-realistic spectacle.
Vanessa, Maeve, and the others watched everything they had gone through themselves, but they no longer felt nearly as tense as before.
After several hours, the illusion finally disappeared.
"There is also a court case against the gods, though that will have to wait." Vritra said.
He had only shown everything up until the final calamity was killed.
"Against the gods?! Again?! Haa... I want to see it so badly." Gunter looked at his son with pleading eyes.
But Ava stopped him.
"They must all be tired. Let them rest for a while."
Hearing her, Gunter finally gave in and watched as everyone left after chatting a little longer.
The women weren't particularly tired since they had gotten plenty of sleep and rest before leaving the game.
But what they wanted now was something entirely different.
They were all thirsty...
And every one of them looked at Vritra with hungry eyes.
Thanks for reading... adios

paragraphs: After sleeping for a few relaxed hours, Vritra woke up.
Finding Vanessa and Yasmine in his arms, both still peacefully asleep.
The previous night had truly been wonderful. Having gotten to drink so much milk, he couldn't help smiling to himself.
When his other wives got pregnant in the future, how wonderful would it be to taste all of their milk as well?
A warm feeling settled in his heart as he looked at the two sleeping beauties. Moments like these made all the dangers they had endured feel worthwhile.
"Good morning, Honey." Vanessa slowly opened her eyes, still looking sleepy.
"Morning. Rest a little longer, I'll ask someone to bring breakfast." Vritra said as he carefully got up, gently moving Yasmine's hand away without disturbing her sleep.
Vanessa simply hummed in response. The previous night had been long and exhausting, and her body still wanted a little more rest.
After getting dressed, Vritra walked outside and asked one of the guards to inform the cooks to prepare breakfast for everyone.
Only then did he head over to freshen up.
About an hour later, everyone had gathered together, enjoying the freshly prepared breakfast.
Yennefer glanced toward Vanessa and Yasmine, feeling a little jealous. She had really wanted to go first.
Unfortunately, she had lost the little game they had played to decide the order.
In fact, she had ended up last.
Still, as compensation, she would eventually get Vritra all to herself, and just thinking about that was enough to brighten her mood again.
"Darling, did Divine tell you how long we can stay here?" Fiona asked while taking a bite of her breakfast.
"No. I'll have a proper talk with him today." Vritra answered. Yesterday, everything had happened so quickly that he never got the chance to ask for the details.
Still, if they were truly going to leave this planet forever, they would also have to leave Gunter and Ava behind.
Those two had long since become part of the family.
Short separations were manageable.
But forever...
That thought weighed heavily on his mind.
Hopefully, Divine already had something planned.
After breakfast, the women all went over to the Yate Palace to spend some time with Ava.
They also planned to go shopping together. It had been so long since they had all enjoyed a peaceful day wandering through markets without worrying about enemies or unexpected attacks.
The news of their return had already spread throughout the city.
Besides shopping, each of them also wanted to visit their respective kingdoms and personally see how everything had been progressing during their absence.
Shitless and Onest also decided to head out together to relax and enjoy themselves for a while.
Of course, this time Onest intended to be much more careful and avoid repeating the mistake he had made previously.
The two of them went straight to a bar.
Now that the demons had been completely wiped out, many hunters had almost lost their livelihoods.
Fortunately, with the disappearance of the demons, dangerous beasts had begun multiplying rapidly throughout the wilderness.
So the hunters had simply changed their targets.
Although it was still morning, the bar was already packed to the brim, with most of the customers being hunters discussing their latest expeditions.
Shitless and Onest walked toward an empty table in the corner.
However, before they could even sit down, a group of arrogant hunters began causing trouble for them.
The two simply tolerated it.
One of the hunters looked toward Onest before bursting into laughter.
"Heh, look at that thief face. Be careful, everyone. They look like they're here to steal something."
Onest secretly felt rather proud.
Had he become so famous that people had actually started recognizing him?
This truly felt like an achievement.
The hunters then shifted their attention toward the monk.
"Is that Baldy really a monk? He looks more like someone who worships devils. What an evil-looking face."
"Really?" Monk Shitless couldn't help grinning.
Since these people were being so generous with their compliments, the two of them decided to let it slide and simply moved toward another empty table.
"Tch. I thought we'd get to see something interesting, but they got scared." the hunters' leader huffed.
Because of the strict laws now in place, fighting was forbidden, and killing was punished even more severely.
As a result, many people had been itching for a chance to vent their frustrations.
"By the way, have you heard? A new organization from the Far East has suddenly begun establishing itself on this continent."
"What organization?" the leader asked curiously.
"It's a group that calls itself RMS. I don't even know what that name means." another hunter replied.
"But why bring them up? Is there something special about them?" the leader asked while chugging down a large mug of beer.
"Yes. Everyone in that organization belongs to a different race, and above all..." After pausing dramatically, the hunter continued,
"They're unbelievably skilled at making glyphs."
The group continued chatting, explaining how the organization was spreading across the continent like wildfire.
The new glyphs they had introduced were considered revolutionary, and countless people wanted to join.
Unfortunately, recruitment was still very limited.
Shitless and Onest exchanged glances.
This sounded like something Vritra should definitely know about.
They silently decided to report it to him later.
For now, however, they simply wanted to relax and enjoy their drinks.
"Hey, Baldy. Wanna go somewhere special that'll finally turn you into a man?" Onest asked with a mysterious grin.

"What do you mean? I am already a man. I don't need someone else's help becoming what I already am. Wait... did someone else turn you into a man? What were you before?" Shitless asked, subtly shifting his chair a little farther away.
Had this guy been after his perfect body all this time?
Shitless suspiciously glanced down at the expensive wine Onest had bought for him, wondering if he had secretly mixed something into it.
"You mugger, I'm warning you. Don't you dare have any funny ideas. Go bother that ugly fellow instead." he said while pointing toward the hunters' leader.
"Shut your trap! What the hell are you even thinking? I meant taking you somewhere you can finally get close to a woman and become a real man." Onest replied in exasperation.
"O-Oh... Heh. I'll wait for my true love. I don't need girls like that." Shitless said while shaking a finger confidently.
"Haha... don't tell me... are you actually scared of women?" Onest asked, his grin growing even wider.
"Huh? Scared? Me? The greatest evil monk of all time? As if!" Shitless declared contemptuously before emptying his glass in a single gulp.
He immediately stood up.
"Let's head back now. We need to start absorbing those energy cores and level up."
Onest simply stared at him.
Now he felt even more convinced that Shitless was genuinely afraid of women.
Thinking back carefully, he realized Shitless had never once tried getting close to any woman.
He was only a monk by title.
There was nothing actually stopping him from being with one.
A mischievous smile slowly spread across Onest's face.
This discovery was simply too entertaining.
Chuckling to himself, he immediately followed after Shitless, determined to tease the poor monk until he finally admitted the truth.

"Ready to tell me?" Onest asked, crossing his arms.
Truthfully, he knew very little about the monk's early life.
Only that he had grown up in a church before eventually getting thrown out after either burning something... or peeing on something.
Even Onest wasn't entirely sure which version was true anymore.
"Sigh... fine..." Shitless sighed before sitting down on a chair outside a roadside stall. The two ordered a couple of cold drinks after the long chase.
Taking a deep breath, the monk finally began.
"It all started when I was born. Being the intelligent creature that I am, everyone used to sing my praises." he spoke in a nostalgic tone, remembering the days when he had just been born.
"Stop the cap and be honest. I won't tell anyone, I swear on my parents." Onest replied with a solemn expression, his eyes filled with absolute sincerity.
Shitless stared at him for several moments before finally nodding.
Since Onest had made such a serious promise, he felt he could finally reveal the truth.
"Actually... I was the dumbest kid in my entire house. Nobody liked me back then except my father... a-and..." A painful expression appeared on his face as he unconsciously rubbed his bald head.

"Whenever I made a mistake, my mother would smack me on the head so hard that I eventually went bald. Around that time I met Bullo, and together we escaped, eventually ending up on this planet." Shitless said, his eyes becoming watery.
Those countless smacks had become a genuine trauma.
He firmly believed they were the true reason behind his baldness.
Fortunately... or unfortunately... thanks to that shiny bald head, he had been accepted into a church despite never wanting to become a monk in the first place.
"Oh... that's actually sad. Having a mother like that couldn't have been easy." Onest gently patted his head, trying to comfort him.
'This guy isn't as bad as I used to think.'
Shitless actually felt a little lighter after sharing those memories.
Very few people knew he originally came from somewhere beyond this planet.
Back there, only the strongest, most destructive and most evil individual could become the ruler of the entire family.
Compared to that place, this world almost felt peaceful.
The monk slowly took another long gulp of his drink.
His mood to continue wandering outside had completely disappeared.
For some reason, remembering those old memories made him want to quietly return home.
"Shall we go bac—"
Looking up from his glass, Shitless suddenly paused.
Onest had disappeared.
Looking around in confusion, he soon spotted him sprinting toward another street.
Curious, Shitless hurried after him.
"Puahahahaha! Hahahahahahaha!"
Explosive laughter echoed throughout the street just as the monk arrived.
Back at the House of Darkness.
Now that everyone else had gone out, Vritra finally found himself alone.
He decided it was the perfect opportunity to ask Divine about the countless questions that had been lingering in his mind ever since they returned.
Sitting atop the House of Darkness, Vritra looked toward the sky before calling out,
"Divine?"

CLAP

Vritra merely rolled his eyes without responding.
"As for the punishment, like I mentioned before, you don't have to worry about going to Hell Prison. She has already made arrangements." Divine lazily explained.
"The Divine Kage will be thrown in your place and spend six months there instead, so nobody will bother you during that time."
Vritra nodded slowly.
Was that the reason Evelyn had insisted they leave the planet?
If they remained here, locating them would be much easier.
Besides, they had to leave eventually anyway to follow Divine's previous instructions.

It wasn't much.
But after everything they had been through, even a single week felt like a precious luxury.
The group of eight beautiful women leisurely walked through the bustling marketplace.

Since they had left the Yate Realm to enjoy a normal shopping trip, most people failed to recognize who they really were.
Naturally, a few arrogant young men still attempted to approach them, believing their wealth, status or appearance would be enough to impress at least one of the women.
However, the moment they stepped closer, they immediately felt the terrifying aura naturally surrounding the group.
Cold sweat appeared on their foreheads.
Without saying another word, they quietly retreated and continued watching from afar.

The place was enormous, occupying enough land to comfortably build an entire village.
Ordinary people with average incomes didn't even dare step inside.
The prices alone were enough to scare most customers away.
Ava, Yennefer, Maeve, Teresa and the others entered before attendants respectfully guided them toward a section reserved for premium clothing.
After everyone had taken their seats, servants immediately began bringing out countless luxurious dresses, gowns and accessories for them to browse.
At almost the same time, another group of well-dressed young men entered the shop, politely greeting the customers.

The moment they did...
They were completely flabbergasted.

chapters.title: Chapter 862 Nit-Wit
paragraphs: "!!!" The two young men at the front, both around twenty, suddenly froze.
For a moment the shop's usual noise dimmed and their hearts thudded in their chests.
The group of ten or so behind them also paused, their gazes drifting in the same direction.
A few muffled whispers ran through the crowd. And they too gasped.
"S-So beautiful..." one guy muttered, all of them in a daze. Even the clink of coins seemed to fade.
A faint hush fell over a nearby display as if the room leaned in.
The two guys were brothers. They didn't look similar, but they were only a few minutes apart in age.
Since birth, they had been surrounded by wealth, enjoying a lavish life.
Their father even owned this shop. He could be said to be a very successful businessman. Barely below only a few of the richest people on the continent like Rich.
Both were good-looking and dressed in expensive clothes, jewels, and whatnot.
The light caught on their collars and rings, throwing brief glints. Most women would do anything to get their attention, mainly because of their wealth.
The two were full of confidence. Still, upon seeing the eight women, they wondered if it was some dream.
They pinched one another and jolted back to their senses. A couple of heads turned, curiosity flickering before returning to normal business.
Such beauties actually existed? Scanning the eight women, they found every one of them otherworldly.
The shop's mirrors seemed dull compared to them. The desires of the two bloomed, wishing to get at least one of them.
With their overflowing confidence, they were sure they could impress them.
"Four yours, four mine." The younger sibling, called Wit, spoke quickly. He drummed his fingers on the counter as if marking territory.
Fully aware of his older brother's habit of trying to hoard everything for himself, there was no way he could give up on these women.
"Haha, fine, fine. But those four are mine. Don't even think of setting your eyes on them."
Nit, the older brother, said, pointing at Vanessa, Yasmine, Yennefer, and Diana.
His tone mixed amusement with command. All of them were too beautiful, so it was difficult to make a choice.
They couldn't see Teresa's face, so Nit didn't choose her.
Wit grimaced, but upon seeing the remaining four, he decided not to fight his elder brother.
Fiona, Maeve, Teresa, and Ava all looked extremely beautiful too. Each carried a different air, but all seemed untouchable.
A tiny ripple of admiration passed through a corner of the shop.
The two brothers were making arrangements among themselves as if these were not women but objects displayed for sale.
Of course, the eight women in question had already noticed them all, but they couldn't care less.
Though they did feel like snapping a finger and making them all disappear, they decided to wait and see if those guys would bother them.
As they bought one thing after another, the group of young men approached them with confident smiles.
The perfume of fabric and cologne mingled, sharpening the tension. A bell above the door chimed faintly, unnoticed by most.
"Hello, ladies. Would you mind if we take a minute of your precious time?" Nit, being the gentleman, spoke gracefully.
"Yes, we do mind, so go somewhere else." Without even turning her head, Yasmine shooed them away.
Nit: "..." He was left standing awkwardly with his hand stretched out, a shocked look on his face.
The sound of faint laughter and mocking from behind made his head burn with shame and anger. His own brother looked at him with a mocking smile.
They didn't even look at him- right, they didn't notice him, which was why they acted like that.

If they knew he was the next owner of this and many other shops, and saw his handsome appearance, they surely wouldn't react the same way. Clearing his throat, he tried to strike up another conversation. He tried to steady his expression, but a slight flush showed.
"COUGH. Beautiful ladies, I think you didn't notice, but I am the son of the owner of this shop, also the heir who will soon own billions-"
While speaking, Nit sat down in the section where the clothes were being presented. He placed himself so everyone could see his face.
Making sure they could all see his face, he believed that after knowing his wealth and seeing his handsome appearance, there was no way any woman could ignore him.
Who wouldn't want to be with someone rich? If they were young, that was even better.
"Who let their pet loose? His voice is so irritating." Fiona dramatically shut her ears with her fingers. A few nearby customers suppressed smiles.
"Ask someone to make them leave." Ava said, frowning at the group of mannerless boys. With her temper, Fiona would have already wiped them out, but she held back solely because Ava was there.

The saleswoman presenting the clothes didn't know what to do. That was the son of their owner, after all. And the owner doted on his sons a lot. Even if they made mistakes, he would cover for them. So they were afraid of offending Nit and Wit.

"Hahaha, this is the first time. Look at his face, and he calls himself a pro!" Wit burst out laughing along with the others. His laugh sounded too loud. A small child peeking from behind a rack giggled then hushed.
Nit gritted his teeth, his anger flaring. But with the strict rules, he couldn't harm these women openly. Since they dared to offend him, however, he decided to make fun of them too.

"Well, I will count to three. Get out of this shop on your own before I ask the guards to throw you out." Nit muttered, folding his arms over his chest and looking at them arrogantly. Since these women were extremely beautiful and hot, he decided to forgive them if they apologized.
"Brother, what a sore loser. Let me get my chance!" Wit complained. He was sure at least one of them would like him.
"Sure, go ahead." Nit smirked and gestured.
"So-" Before he could even speak a word, Maeve spoke with a frown.
"Get lost!" Her single-word dismissal landed hard.
"..." The boys around Wit burst out laughing again, and now his head burned with shame. Their bravado trembled.
"Brother, you were right. These women should never be allowed in any of our shops. Now just throw them out!" Wit shouted.
"Three..." Nit raised his hand, three fingers pointing up.
The group of women looked at one another and couldn't help but laugh at their childish display. Their quiet laughter only irked the brothers even more.
"Two!" Nit continued, his face twisted. He would make sure to find out who they were and send his men after these women.
He had abducted a few women he liked already, but they all gave in after he gave them enough money.
"One!" Finally, all his fingers curled, and he gave the command, "Guards, throw these eight ladies out of the shop and make sure not to show them any respect."
The other customers in the shop looked at the group of women with some pity, mainly the men. A few exchanged uneasy glances.
The women, however, felt jealous of their looks, so they were quite satisfied, laughing in their hearts.
Several of the guards who had been silently watching the drama sighed.
They really wanted to beat up these brats but could do nothing.
Despite the order, they approached slowly, hoping the women would leave on their own.
"M-Mr. Nit, it wouldn't be good to t-treat them like this. I don't think your f-father would be happy about this."
The saleswoman, despite being afraid, mustered all her courage and spoke. Her voice trembled, but she tried nonetheless.

She even mentioned their father, hoping to create some pressure. But it instead backfired, making the two brothers glare at her, and she knew her life was finished. She shouldn't have spoken up, but she simply felt they were being unreasonable.
"Throw these women out! What are you dawdling there for? After I deal with them, I will take care of you. How dare you try to threaten me!"
Nit roared, shouting at the guards.
The guards shook their heads and quickly approached the group of women, who just sat there calmly, as if a good drama were being played.
The shop seemed to hold its breath. A few customers edged closer to watch.
"M-Miss, can you please leave?" one of the guards asked, not daring to use force.
"You lowly bastard, you are going against my order?! Good. You all have families here, right?
I guess it is time we recruit new guards and remove the old ones." Wit copied his brother and roared out the threats.
"!!!" The guards shook, fear creeping into their hearts.
Vanessa rolled her eyes. These guards were helpless, so she gave an order.
"Go out." The word landed like a quiet command.
The guards, as if being controlled, nodded and left the shop, leaving the two brothers fuming. Their retreat was stiff and shamefaced.
"Where the fuck do you think you are going? You're listening to her orders, not mine!"
Nit stomped his feet. He had never been so angry.
He really was going to slaughter them all.
"Bro, want me to deal with them?" the boys in the group grinned, looking at the beautiful women.
They licked their lips and took a step forward. A bead of sweat trickled down one boy's temple.
While throwing them out, they would at least get to touch them, so they walked forward while practically salivating.
The air felt charged, like a sudden storm about to break. A low murmur rose among customers sensing trouble.
Thanks for reading...
