chapters.title: Chapter 863 A Cruel Punishment
paragraphs: Nit and Wit were brimming with rage, contacting their father so he could take care of these guards, that saleswoman. Their fingers trembled slightly on the device, anger and fear mixing in their chests.
And finally, all eight of these women. In their minds, they had already sentenced them.
They glanced at one another and decided to wait a bit. If only Vritra was here, he would surely have enjoyed the drama. The thought alone made a few of them smirk.
Or maybe wiped them out without giving them any chance. That, too, would have been entertaining.
In any case, as they waited, before long a man about five feet tall with a pot belly huffed and rushed towards them. His breathing was loud and uneven, drawing the attention of several customers.
Following him was a large group of powerful guards, already with their weapons in their hands. The air felt heavier as they filed into the shop.
The pot-bellied man with thinning hair quickly approached his sons and looked them up and down with worry. He checked their faces as if expecting blood and bruises.
"Nit, Wit, are you both okay? What happened? Tell me, I will tear anyone apart!" the owner shouted, the fat on his face shivering. His voice echoed through the room.

"Dad, it's those guards. They didn't listen to us and left. That saleswoman tried to threaten us, and these eight women shamelessly humiliated us. Even though we were so respectful, they kept cursing us and even you!!"
Wit, the younger brother, quickly summarized. His tone was full of grievance, eyes moist with fake injustice.
"How dare they!!" The pot-bellied man turned to glare at the guards who were standing near the entrance. His gaze was sharp despite his round body.
They shivered under his glare. Then he looked at the saleswoman, who sat there lifelessly.
She was sure her dead body would soon be thrown into the forest in pieces, or maybe an even worse fate awaited her. Her fingers curled on her skirt, knuckles turning white.
Making her wonder if suicide would be a better option than that. The idea scared her as much as the man himself.
Finally, his gaze shifted to the eight women, his eyes literally seeming about to spit fire. The room grew strangely quiet at that moment.
But upon seeing them, he was first shocked at how beautiful they all were, then a realization dawned on him.
He seemed to recognize a few of their faces. His heart began to pound wildly.
The first he recognized was Ava. She was the wife of the current head of the Yate family.
And the Yate family was currently the most powerful family. He double-checked to make sure he wasn't mistaken. His throat went dry.
But no matter what, even if he rubbed his eyes, the result was the same. She really was the wife of Gunter Yate.
His heart skipped a beat, and sweat began to pour down his body. A few drops rolled down his temples.
He then glanced at the other women. After a moment, he recognized another.
'I-Isn't that the Empress of the Phoenix Race? S-She is here too?!! What the-' he almost cried upon seeing her. His knees felt weak.
She was pretty famous for killing anyone who made her upset. Just remembering a few rumors made him shiver.
He continued to look and then saw Yasmine. Although she had disappeared for a long time.
As one of the top businessmen, he had seen her image before and immediately knew she was the Dragon Empress.
A very powerful dragoness. Someone he never imagined he would meet inside his own shop.
He didn't recognize Teresa at first, but based on the women she was with, the pot-bellied man soon concluded.
That she must be Teresa, who had married a very powerful guy. That alone made her terrifying.
Then came Vanessa, who was the Queen of the Succubi. Though she didn't make many public appearances before, being one of the more influential people, he had seen her.
Maeve wasn't well known since her organization was rather hidden, but she had been seen with these women before. He forced himself not to look away.
And finally, he looked at Diana, and he suddenly lost all strength in his legs, stumbling and supporting himself on his sons.
The world began to spin. Even if he was extremely rich, what could he even do against them? His earlier anger vanished without a trace.
"Heh. You all are done now. With my father here, you will suffer so much you will come to regret being born!" Nit shouted.

Both Nit and Wit were gloating now, waiting to see those women beg. Previously, they had planned to take them as their wives, but now they could at most be slaves. Their imagination ran wild with twisted scenarios.
"Oh, it seems your father is very powerful. But I just so happen to be the Empress of this continent." Diana smiled faintly as she stood up.
"Hahaha. You are wha-" Wit was about to joke when his father suddenly fell to his knees and began to smash his head on the floor. The sound of his forehead hitting the tiles was sickening.
"E-Empress, please forgive me, I beg you..." His pot belly was shaking because of fear.
"D-Dad, what are you doing? She is obviously lying. There is no way she can be the Empre-" But before he could speak, the man suddenly stood up and slapped his son with all his might.
Nit fell, his face smashing into one of the chairs, breaking his nose. Blood spilled instantly.
"You stupid bastard, how dare you act so arrogant in front of Empress Goddess Diana!!" he shouted at his son, then slapped Wit. The second slap rang even louder.
Again falling in front of the eight women, the pot-bellied man began to beg, shaking violently. His forehead was already bruised.
Only now did Nit and Wit begin to understand that these women weren't normal. Had they just provoked the Empress of the entire continent? The weight of that realization crushed their arrogance.
The two brothers suddenly felt nervous and a gripping pain in their hearts, falling to the floor. Their legs refused to support them.
"It's alright, they are young, so they would make mistakes." Vanessa spoke gently. Her calm tone contrasted the bloody tension in the room.
"T-Thank you. I will do exactly as you instruct. Please tell me your orders." The owner quickly spoke, a bit relieved that they were ready to forgive them.
Teresa cut in and spoke, "I have an idea. How about we let only one out of you three live?"
With a sweet smile under the veil, she clapped gently and added, "Start fighting. The winner gets to walk out of here alive."
"N-No, pleaseee give us one chance." The pot-bellied man began to cry, understanding the horror of her words. Tears mixed with sweat on his cheeks.
This was more cruel than killing them all. How could he bring himself to kill his children?
Both Nit and Wit were just shivering, not knowing what to do. Their minds went blank.
"You have one minute to start. If not, you will be eaten by them piece by piece." Diana spoke, creating terrifying zombie-like monsters from the Illusion Halo.
The sight scared the three as the zombies kept inching closer. Their grotesque forms made other customers look away.
Nit, while shaking, looked around and soon saw a metal scale. He picked it up and stabbed his father with it.
"Aggghhhh! Y-You little bitch!!" the pot-bellied man screamed in pain, not expecting his son to do that.
Unfortunately, the scale wasn't sharp enough, so he pulled it away and then kicked his son. His kick was clumsy but desperate.
But Wit was ready. He kicked his father's crotch, then picked up the scale. His face twisted in panic and madness.
Another heart-wrenching scream rang out as the man fell while clutching his crotch.
He saw his younger son trying to slit his throat with the scale. Filled with endless rage, he decided to kill them both. His eyes turned bloodshot.
He could just get more sons if he survived. That cruel thought flashed through his mind.
So he stopped the scale at the last second and punched Wit's face hard. The impact made Wit's vision blur.
Then a dogfight began as they punched and kicked one another, biting, poking, doing anything and everything they could.
The women watched as it turned all bloody and brutal. Those three were fighting as if their opponents were mortal enemies. The floor around them slowly turned red.
"..." Ava looked at it and felt uneasy. She didn't like seeing such violence. Her fingers tightened around her dress.
Seeing her turn her head, Yasmine couldn't help but chuckle, internally asking, 'First time?'
As Vritra's mother, she would probably get used to it. Anyone around him got a bit corrupted.
Just look at Teresa. How kind she used to be, and now she was the one to suggest such a gruesome punishment.
Just killing the three would have been more merciful. That simple option had been discarded.
Vritra, who was in the Yate Realm and had finished his talk with Divine, had seen this scene, but he didn't feel like intervening.
All of his wives seemed to be handling it really well. Then he looked at Shitless and Onest.
Frowning when he saw Onest shouting something loudly while the poor monk kept trying to silence him. Their little argument was a strange contrast to the brutal fight.
He didn't think much of it and was already preparing to start absorbing the leveling-up cores.
Setting up rooms where time would pass quicker so they could be done faster. He moved with practiced calm.
But this time they would have to absorb from Level 4 to 7, so it would still take quite some time.
On the other side, the pot-bellied man tore off Wit's throat with his mouth, killing his younger son. The sound was sickening.
While Nit fearfully tore open his father's belly with a broken piece of glass, terrified after seeing the dead body of his younger brother.
Even more determined to kill his father. His hands were shaking, but his resolve was firm.

But before long, the pot-bellied man managed to kill Nit, though he had suffered major injuries while crushing Nit's head into a bloody pulp. His breathing turned ragged as he finally collapsed to his knees.
His entire body covered in blood and flesh, as the man held onto his belly to stop the content inside from spilling out.
Feeling immense pain in his heart for killing his dear child, he buried the vengeance in his chest.
Sooner or later, he will definitely bring justice to his children and punish the murderers of his child, with enough money he can do it.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 864 Level 7!
paragraphs: After looking at the dead bodies of his two sons, the pot-bellied man felt pain. His chest tightened, and for a brief second he almost lost his balance.
But he didn't dare linger there anymore. After bowing towards the group of women. His bow was stiff and shallow, more from fear than respect.
He quickly started walking towards the exit. Each step felt strangely heavy, yet he forced himself to move faster.
Vanessa, Maeve, and the rest just watched him leave in silence, staying true to their words. Their gazes were calm, completely devoid of pity.
They looked at the dead bodies and sighed. First, that man had made his sons poisonous to society, and in the end, this was the result. The smell of blood lingered faintly in the air.
Normally, parents would rather die than hurt their own children like this, and children usually wouldn't turn against their parents. It was one of those basic truths of the world.
But they didn't feel any pity towards these people. To them, this was simply cause and effect.
As soon as the pot-bellied man was out of the shop, Diana pulled out a glyph and contacted someone. The glyph glowed faintly in her hand.
Ordering them to remove that man and the rotten people in power related to him from the continent, killing them if necessary. Her voice remained casual despite the severity of the order.
After they were done, Diana looked at the saleswoman and spoke, "You can manage this place under the new owner."
"...Oh." The saleswoman was so shocked that she dazedly stared for a couple of minutes. Her lips parted, but no words came out.
And by then, all of the women had taken whatever clothes they liked and disappeared. It was as if they had never been there at all.
From thinking of committing suicide, she had suddenly been promoted to oversee the entire shop as its manager. The contrast made her dizzy.
The promotion was generational, simply astronomical. Her future, which had seemed pitch-black, was suddenly bright.
Crying, she bowed towards where the women had been seated. Tears dripped down onto the floor.
The whole ordeal had spoiled their moods, so without going anywhere else, they decided to return home. None of them felt like continuing the outing.
While flying, they decided to let Rich handle this business too. It was easier to entrust such matters to him.
They would be leaving this planet anyway, and money was meaningless. At their level, wealth was just a tool.
Before long, the eight were back in the Yate Realm and found Vritra resting in his room. The atmosphere inside was quiet and peaceful.
"You had quite the time, huh?" he spoke without opening his eyes. His tone carried mild amusement.
"Not really, we would have preferred a peaceful shopping trip over this." Yasmine spoke and landed beside him on the bed.
"So when are we starting?" the goddess asked. She sat near his head and began to gently comb his hair with her fingers.
She really enjoyed the feel of his long, silky hair, while Vritra enjoyed her tenderness. It always calmed him.
"I am ready, just waiting for Onest and Shitless to return." Vritra replied, finally opening his eyes. His gaze was relaxed yet sharp.
"I will go inform Ava about this." Vanessa said, to which the others decided to tag along. They exchanged brief nods.
They would be gone for over a month after all. It wasn't a short trip by any means.
Before long, all eight of them were standing in front of Ava and Gunter. The couple's home felt warm and lived-in.
"You are disappearing again?" Ava asked, a pout on her face. Her eyes betrayed clear worry.
"We will just be in that house. It's nothing dangerous." Maeve reassured her with a smile. Her tone was soft.
"Still, you had just returned, and now you will be gone for over a month..." Ava felt sad. She thought they would at least get to spend some time together.
But Gunter excitedly asked, "So you are going to absorb those leveling cores and reach Level 7 Demi Gods?! Cool!"
Vritra and the others couldn't help but laugh at his enthusiasm. He definitely wanted to become a Demi God. His excitement was contagious.
But for now, it wasn't possible. The gap between them was still too wide.
They chatted for a bit, and just then Onest and Shitless returned. Their timing was perfect.
Onest had handprints over both his cheeks. In the end, he let his guard down and Shitless landed a few attacks.
"...Just finish it quickly, and after that you won't be going anywhere. You will have to spend more time with me." Ava muttered reluctantly. Her voice was low.
"Yes, we will spend time with you." They all nodded and soon left the couple, who could only sigh.
At least they were pretty close this time. The distance felt less cruel than before.
Returning inside the House of Darkness.
Vritra made the Soul Wraiths protect the house and the Yate Realm while they would be away. Their ghostly forms hovered silently.
Onest and Shitless entered their own rooms. Each sat down, took out all the cores, and started absorbing the energy right away.
They paid no mind to the messages popping up before them. The notifications were irrelevant.
In another room, Vritra sat with his wives in the large room where they all took out the energy cores. The cores gave off a subtle glow.
After some light talk, they didn't waste much time and started the absorption process too.
The time inside the rooms started moving faster compared to the outside. Space itself seemed to twist around them.
Their consciousness was submerged into darkness, as if falling into a slumber, and time lost its meaning.
The auras of the ten were increasing gradually. Each heartbeat carried more power.
Vritra had also used the Book of Dimensions just in case. The ancient pages floated lazily nearby.
While in the outside world, after a brief stir, things soon returned to calm. Daily life continued.
Rich successfully took over the new business after hearing about the fate of the previous owner. He didn't miss opportunities.
That pot-bellied man was a very clever businessman and always took precautions.
Yet his children became the reason for his demise. In the end, his own blood betrayed him.
Just like that, two months passed. The long period went by unnoticed inside the accelerated rooms.
It was dawn, a new peaceful day in the Yate Realm. A soft light bathed the streets.
People were going to their work, children were playing in the streets, the place as bustling as ever. Laughter echoed faintly.
Suddenly, the House of Darkness started trembling, and it rose to such a degree that everyone in the Yate Realm could sense the tremors.
Being close by, Ava and Gunter sensed it too and moved out to check it out. Their expressions turned serious.
They worriedly looked at the House of Darkness, hoping that nothing had gone wrong with Vritra and the others.
Inside the large house, the various layers of protection that Vritra had created started to crumble.
The shields couldn't hold against just the leaking auras from the ten Demi Gods. Cracks spread across the barriers.
The house thankfully didn't break apart, and in the end, it was the pages of the Book of Dimensions that Vritra had left behind that contained the powerful auras.
As they all finished absorbing the final energy core one by one, several powerful explosions sounded, scaring everyone in the Yate Realm. Shock rippled through the populace.
The first to wake up was Onest, who quickly stabilized his energy and stopped it from wreaking havoc. His control was firm and precise.
Opening his eyes, he sensed the changes in his body and felt an unbelievable leap in his strength.
His body had literally transformed into something far more powerful. Just a breath would be enough to kill even Level 3 or Level 4 Demi Gods.
Even his skin, flesh, bones, and everything else had gone through major changes.
"This feeling is... just as good as stealing." Onest muttered, a big smile breaking onto his face.
But then he wondered how much Vritra's strength would increase after this. He was already so powerful.
His physique would undergo extreme changes. Setting aside the Titan for now, just the Dust Manipulation would be on a whole another level.
Plus, Dust Manipulation had combined with Blood Manipulation. Onest shivered at the thought. Thankfully, he wouldn't have to fight Vritra.
After properly observing the changes and dressing up in a new set of clothes, since the old ones were completely gone, he walked out. His steps felt lighter.
On the other side, Shitless didn't release such powerful mana bursts. His aura was different.
Since he was purely a physique-type fighter, he didn't possess any mana, which made his body all the more dangerous.
"Heh, Mugger, wanna have a fight?" Shitless looked at him with a provoking expression. His grin was wide.
"You sure seem confident. Fine, this time you won't even be able to touch me." Onest retorted, then chuckled.
In the other room, some distance away.
One by one, all the women began to wake up, stabilizing their energy cores. Their eyes slowly opened.
They sensed that their violent auras could create disasters, but thankfully Vritra had prepared for it.
They all too just sat cross-legged and observed the changes, sensing the astronomical leap.
From Level 3 to Level 7, the difference was unbelievably large. It felt like crossing several worlds.
And once they were done, their gazes moved to Vritra, who still sat cross-legged with his eyes closed.
He had created an additional barrier around himself, and many pages of the Book of Dimensions fluttered around him.
Trying to contain the violent bursts of aura, which were at least a thousand times more powerful than all of theirs combined.
They all looked at him in bafflement. It was mainly thanks to his physique and SSS Rank skill.
Thankfully, Vritra had even created several dust barriers around himself while unconscious. Fine particles swirled like a protective storm.
They observed for a bit, and soon Vritra woke up too, and the first thing he saw was his beautiful wives.
All looking back at him.
Their clothes couldn't hold together either, and they weren't shy in front of him, so they had yet to dress up.
Vritra contained his violent aura and stabilized his ocean of mana. The raging flow slowly calmed.
Honestly, even he was surprised by the changes. The amount of mana in his body was hundreds of thousands of times greater.
Maybe only as he grew stronger would his physique, bloodline, and skills show their full potential.
Then what when he became a god?
When he became a higher being or even surpassed that?
Well, those thoughts could wait. Now it was time to progress. Only four months remained before they challenged the gods.
Thanks for reading...

She thought they would at least get to spend some time together.
But Gunter excitedly asked, "So you are going to absorb those leveling cores and reach Level 7 Demi Gods?!
Cool!"
Vritra and the others couldn't help but laugh at his enthusiasm.
He definitely wanted to become a Demi God.
His excitement was contagious.
But for now, it wasn't possible.
The gap between them was still too wide.
They chatted for a bit, and just then Onest and Shitless returned.
Their timing was perfect.
Onest had handprints over both his cheeks.
In the end, he let his guard down and Shitless landed a few attacks.
"...Just finish it quickly, and after that you won't be going anywhere.
You will have to spend more time with me." Ava muttered reluctantly.
Her voice was low.
"Yes, we will spend time with you." They all nodded and soon left the couple, who could only sigh.
At least they were pretty close this time.
The distance felt less cruel than before.
Returning inside the House of Darkness.
Vritra made the Soul Wraiths protect the house and the Yate Realm while they would be away.
Their ghostly forms hovered silently.
Onest and Shitless entered their own rooms.
Each sat down, took out all the cores, and started absorbing the energy right away.
They paid no mind to the messages popping up before them.
The notifications were irrelevant.
In another room, Vritra sat with his wives in the large room where they all took out the energy cores.
The cores gave off a subtle glow.
After some light talk, they didn't waste much time and started the absorption process too.
The time inside the rooms started moving faster compared to the outside.
Space itself seemed to twist around them.
Their consciousness was submerged into darkness, as if falling into a slumber, and time lost its meaning.
The auras of the ten were increasing gradually.
Each heartbeat carried more power.
Vritra had also used the Book of Dimensions just in case.
The ancient pages floated lazily nearby.
While in the outside world, after a brief stir, things soon returned to calm.
Daily life continued.
Rich successfully took over the new business after hearing about the fate of the previous owner.
He didn't miss opportunities.
That pot-bellied man was a very clever businessman and always took precautions.
Yet his children became the reason for his demise.
In the end, his own blood betrayed him.
Just like that, two months passed.
The long period went by unnoticed inside the accelerated rooms.
It was dawn, a new peaceful day in the Yate Realm.
A soft light bathed the streets.
People were going to their work, children were playing in the streets, the place as bustling as ever.
Laughter echoed faintly.
Suddenly, the House of Darkness started trembling, and it rose to such a degree that everyone in the Yate Realm could sense the tremors.
Being close by, Ava and Gunter sensed it too and moved out to check it out.
Their expressions turned serious.
They worriedly looked at the House of Darkness, hoping that nothing had gone wrong with Vritra and the others.
Inside the large house, the various layers of protection that Vritra had created started to crumble.
The shields couldn't hold against just the leaking auras from the ten Demi Gods.
Cracks spread across the barriers.
The house thankfully didn't break apart, and in the end, it was the pages of the Book of Dimensions that Vritra had left behind that contained the powerful auras.
As they all finished absorbing the final energy core one by one, several powerful explosions sounded, scaring everyone in the Yate Realm.
Shock rippled through the populace.
The first to wake up was Onest, who quickly stabilized his energy and stopped it from wreaking havoc.
His control was firm and precise.
Opening his eyes, he sensed the changes in his body and felt an unbelievable leap in his strength.
His body had literally transformed into something far more powerful.
Just a breath would be enough to kill even Level 3 or Level 4 Demi Gods.
Even his skin, flesh, bones, and everything else had gone through major changes.
"This feeling is... just as good as stealing." Onest muttered, a big smile breaking onto his face.
But then he wondered how much Vritra's strength would increase after this.
He was already so powerful.
His physique would undergo extreme changes.
Setting aside the Titan for now, just the Dust Manipulation would be on a whole another level.
Plus, Dust Manipulation had combined with Blood Manipulation.
Onest shivered at the thought.
Thankfully, he wouldn't have to fight Vritra.
After properly observing the changes and dressing up in a new set of clothes, since the old ones were completely gone, he walked out.
His steps felt lighter.
On the other side, Shitless didn't release such powerful mana bursts.
His aura was different.
Since he was purely a physique-type fighter, he didn't possess any mana, which made his body all the more dangerous.
"Heh, Mugger, wanna have a fight?" Shitless looked at him with a provoking expression.
His grin was wide.
"You sure seem confident.
Fine, this time you won't even be able to touch me." Onest retorted, then chuckled.
In the other room, some distance away.
One by one, all the women began to wake up, stabilizing their energy cores.
Their eyes slowly opened.
They sensed that their violent auras could create disasters, but thankfully Vritra had prepared for it.
They all too just sat cross-legged and observed the changes, sensing the astronomical leap.
From Level 3 to Level 7, the difference was unbelievably large.
It felt like crossing several worlds.
And once they were done, their gazes moved to Vritra, who still sat cross-legged with his eyes closed.
He had created an additional barrier around himself, and many pages of the Book of Dimensions fluttered around him.
Trying to contain the violent bursts of aura, which were at least a thousand times more powerful than all of theirs combined.
They all looked at him in bafflement.
It was mainly thanks to his physique and SSS Rank skill.
Thankfully, Vritra had even created several dust barriers around himself while unconscious.
Fine particles swirled like a protective storm.
They observed for a bit, and soon Vritra woke up too, and the first thing he saw was his beautiful wives.
All looking back at him.
Their clothes couldn't hold together either, and they weren't shy in front of him, so they had yet to dress up.
Vritra contained his violent aura and stabilized his ocean of mana.
The raging flow slowly calmed.
Honestly, even he was surprised by the changes.
The amount of mana in his body was hundreds of thousands of times greater.
Maybe only as he grew stronger would his physique, bloodline, and skills show their full potential.
Then what when he became a god?
When he became a higher being or even surpassed that?
Well, those thoughts could wait.
Now it was time to progress.
Only four months remained before they challenged the gods.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 865 RMS
paragraphs: After Vritra's thoughts and aura had calmed down, he glanced back at his wives again.
Their appearances didn't have any major changes, but they looked prettier, their skin looking more supple and glowy than before.
And finally, his gaze landed on Yasmine. Now that it had almost been four months since her pregnancy began, a slight bump was visible, but still nothing that made her look obviously pregnant.
Though she looked hotter, especially since they were all naked right now.
But controlling their urges, they didn't start anything and quickly got dressed.
'They have all gotten pretty strong.' Vritra thought, gazing at the beautiful faces of his wives. He could clearly sense how much stronger their auras had become.
"Dear, are you really just at the 7th level like us?" Diana asked.
All of them were special in one way or another and could defeat most Level 7 Demi Gods, but Vritra appeared far more terrifying.
"Of course, I am only at Level 7." While chatting, they walked out and found Shitless and Onest there.
"You are also at Level 7?" Onest asked the same question doubtfully, carefully sensing Vritra's aura.
Rolling his eyes, Vritra nodded. Together, they made their way outside and decided to meet Ava and Gunter.
But just as they walked out of the House of Darkness, a bug flew up before them.
"Divine?" Vritra asked, narrowing his eyes.
"Yes, it is me-"
SLAP
Vritra directly hit him after confirming and asked, "What is it? What bad news have you brought?"
"Ughh, why has hitting me become your greeting?" Divine complained, then sighed.
"Anyway, there is a change of plans. We aren't going to meet the Crying Monk directly. Instead, we will be directly entering the Higher Beings' Realm!"
"..." All of them heard it and were speechless, not knowing what to say.
"Are you stupid? Isn't this straight-up suicide?" Shitless shouted. After all, even his patience had limits.
Even he couldn't tolerate his pet being so stupid.
"Why the sudden change? Before anything, you better explain things properly!" Vritra said, his glare almost creating a hole in the insect.
"Alright, alright." Divine crumbled under everyone's pressure and started explaining.

"Some sort of deadly disease spread around several planets, which two brothers called something like Raka Zaka were carrying, and it led to some serious problems. The Crying Monk sort of isn't available for a bit."
Vritra didn't interrupt, but he felt that those names sounded a little familiar, and he didn't have to think long before he remembered.
Those were the Level 4 or 5 Demi Gods who had come to the Zoratian planet to kill him and his family but instead were manipulated into wiping out the Divine Kage.
And when they were leaving, he had gotten a Level 1 Demi God's corpse from them and given a deadly virus to the older brother.
Even fooling the younger one into secretly making his older brother drink the potion, which must have made the virus much worse.
Vritra had almost forgotten about that. He had done it only to retaliate against the two since they came to harm his family.
So that's why they couldn't meet with the Crying Monk? Vritra didn't know what to say. Somehow, something he had done so long ago had returned to affect their current plans.
"And aside from that place, there is only one other place where you can currently stay, and only one other person who can help you." Divine added, fully aware of how that disease had spread.
Such things couldn't be predicted in advance, so along the way, the plans had to keep changing and adapting.
"But wouldn't living there as mere Level 7 Demi Gods be far too dangerous?" Yennefer couldn't help but raise the question.
"Yeah, you just need to be careful, and a certain someone insisted that you all go there as soon as possible. She has made arrangements, is all that woman said." Divine said as if shrugging.
Vritra's frown deepened. This was too random. Entering the Higher Beings' society as mere Demi Gods, among beings who kept gods as servants, how was this wise?
And of course, he knew which woman Divine was talking about.
"And we bring Ava and Gunter there with us? This is just impossible." Vanessa spoke, shaking her head.
"Don't worry, with Evelyn around, you will be 100% safe." Divine said. He also wasn't able to reject Evelyn.
It was mainly because of her. Since she wanted to be with Vritra so badly, and since the Crying Monk could also go to the Higher Beings' Realm, this arrangement would work too.
Evelyn couldn't wait any longer and felt this was the perfect opportunity. After becoming gods, they could then climb up to become Higher Beings.

"Yeah, it is too sudden and sounds dangerous, but for the next four months you will mostly be training and then challenging the gods. After that, the path to becoming Higher Beings will open, and things will be fine." Divine spoke in a calming tone.
Vritra and the others could only sigh. It felt like their lives were being led around by others, but they didn't really have any choice right now.
Despite it all, Vritra still couldn't trust Divine 100%, nor Evelyn. After all, one could never be too careful.
What if they had some hidden motive?
Yet weakness meant one couldn't control their fate, whether in this supernatural world or back on Earth.
"How long do we have before we leave?" Vritra asked after staying silent for a few moments.
"Whenever you are ready within a week." Divine wanted to say right away but changed his words.
"...Alright, we will think it through till then." Vritra nodded and, with his mind full of various thoughts, started walking away with the others.
"Hubby, is this really okay? What if the Higher Beings find out?" Yasmine asked, worry etched on her face.
"I will go check things out first." Vritra replied, unable to think of any other solution.
"But that's still too dangerous. The Higher Beings aren't bound by rules like the gods, they can kill us." The goddess spoke, her tone heavy.
"Yes, and we know too little." Teresa added.
"...Uh, how about I go there first?" Shitless asked. Since he could survive almost any situation, he decided to take the risk.
"Perfect!" all nine others exclaimed at the same time. Shitless survived all sorts of situations, no matter how ridiculous they became.
For whatever reason, Divine had kept him alive.
"It is settled then." Vritra finally smiled. Now he no longer felt worried. Thankfully, they had gotten a guinea pig.
One that volunteered himself.
"Uh... wait, upon thinking about it twice-" Shitless suddenly began to regret his impulsive words, but it was too late.
Soon, Vritra found Ava. Gunter had gone out for some work.
"You all look more stunning than before. Leveling up even improves your appearance?" Ava asked in surprise, wishing she could also go through that.
For the first time, she had the same urge as her husband. She had already gotten to the Lord Rank, but comparison was the killer of joy.
"You both will be able to grow strong later, once we all have grown to a certain level." Vritra said, easing Ava's thoughts.
Shaking her head, she got rid of the useless thoughts and happily looked at Yasmine.
"My daughter, you aren't feeling any discomfort, right? Tell me what you want to eat. Today, lunch will be of your choice." Ava asked, sitting beside her.
"Yup, I'm fine. As for lunch..." After thinking, Yasmine mentioned a few spicy dishes.
She was really craving them.
"Have you heard of RMS?" Onest asked, remembering it as they waited for the food.
Ava had already told the cooks about all the dishes.
"No, what is it?" Vritra asked, the others waiting for an answer too.
"It's some group from outside this continent, but suddenly they are moving into this continent and expanding quickly." Onest replied.
Vritra frowned. He didn't think that even with such strict rules, someone would still dare to cause trouble.
"Are they creating chaos?" he asked after a moment.
"No, no. They are good at creating glyphs and have very creative and new types of glyphs, which allowed them to make big money." Shitless was the one to answer.
"Oh." Vritra's mind went straight to the creator of the glyphs, Rodrick Mecha.
Could it be related to him? Aside from Divine, that person was the only one who was so mysterious and had changed this planet so much.
Glyphs were such a wonderful creation with seemingly limitless possibilities.
"What else do you know about it?" Vritra asked, suddenly more interested in it.
"Nothing else. They are spreading these new types of glyphs everywhere." Onest said.
"Oh, you are all finally done! Level 7 Demi Gods?" Gunter exclaimed, a big smile breaking onto his face as he walked into the hall.
"Yes. By the way, do you know about RMS?" Vritra asked.
"Yes, someone contacted me, saying they want to do business in the Yate Realm. Those new glyphs are even better." Gunter said, his eyes glittering with excitement.
"What's so different?" Teresa asked, her curiosity piqued.
"Unlike before, one glyph is able to carry various functionalities. Those glyphs can even store living beings now and much more!" Gunter replied enthusiastically.
"Master, how about I ask someone to bring in more information?" Maeve asked. The World Information Centre organization was still working.
"Yeah, do that. I'll check it out before we leave." Vritra nodded, but Ava's baffled voice suddenly sounded.
"You are leaving again? B-But... is it a game again?"
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 866 A Tour of Nostalgia
paragraphs: Ava was worried and troubled upon hearing that they would be leaving soon. Her heart felt heavy, and a faint anxiety settled in her chest.
So Vritra decided to show them the final part of the game, the court part; the previous time, he had left it out. He hadn't wanted to burden them with that scene earlier.
Mainly because of this reason. He wanted them to understand everything before making a choice.
Using the misty essence, he displayed the court case and how he fought against the gods. The mist swirled and formed clear images before their eyes.
Gunter seemed very proud, even clapping and laughing; he couldn't believe the people present there were all so powerful. The scale of the courtroom left him stunned.
And finally, they saw the last part, where the ten received the punishment. The atmosphere in the room turned heavy.
"Oh..." Ava stared at the screen, not knowing what to say. Her lips trembled slightly.
But Vritra then explained that they don't really need to go to the prison but will be leaving the planet. His tone remained calm as he clarified things.

"We would be staying among the higher beings, which is very dangerous. So it is your choice whether or not you want to leave everything here and go with us or just stay here. Maybe it will take a long time, but I am sure we will be able to return here," Vritra said. He believed the first choice was better for them.
They would at least stay safe, but he wasn't sure if they would get to meet ever again. That uncertainty bothered him more than he admitted.
What if it's so late that by the time he returns, they had already passed away? The thought made his chest tighten.
Also, leaving all this wouldn't be easy; they were rulers here, top of the chain.
It wouldn't be easy to leave for most people. Power and status were hard to abandon.
Vritra was deep in thoughts while giving them time to think it over; there was still a week, so he wasn't in a hurry for answers. He silently watched their expressions.
"When are we leaving?" Gunter's body flashed, and in the next moment he returned with a bag, already packed to the brim. He had clearly decided long ago.
"..." They all rolled their eyes; wasn't he a bit too zealous? His enthusiasm was almost comical.
"After a week, so use this time to 'properly' think this through," Vritra said, emphasizing his words. He wanted them to be sure.

"What's there to think? You think I would want to separate from my son? Not see my little grandchild? This can be built again, I have ruled enough, I am already tired. I would have preferred if you had taken over," Gunter said solemnly.

"Hmph, aren't you just wishing to be a Demi God or see those higher beings and gods up close?" Ava said, but she too was ready to give up this Yate Realm and their status here if it meant getting to be together as a family. Deep down, her decision was the same.
But she replied in a calm tone: "Okay, we will think about this properly." Her voice remained steady.
"Tsk, it's not like you would choose any of this over your children, so why wait?" Gunter said, only becoming silent when Ava glared at him. That single look shut him up instantly.
The group laughed upon seeing that; their relationship was still so good.
They quarrelled, joked around, but still loved each other dearly even after so long. Those small arguments only showed their closeness.
The women were all happy that their own relation with Vritra was just as good, if not better. They felt secure beside him.
Only Shitless and Onest wished they too could have a life like that, but they weren't in a hurry. Their paths were different, and they knew it.
While they chatted, one of the servants informed them that the lunch had been prepared. The smell of food already drifted faintly through the corridors.
Arriving in the dining hall, the table was soon filled with dozens of various dishes; most were what Yasmine had asked for. The colourful plates made the hall look festive.
"Yasmine, do you want a son or daughter?" While eating, Ava asked curiously. She leaned forward slightly, genuinely interested.
"...I would be happy with either, be it a daughter or a son," Yasmine replied after thinking for a moment. She smiled softly as she spoke.
Ava didn't press on, instead turned to look at her son. Her eyes held warmth.
"What about you?"
Vritra replied without even thinking: "Of course a daughter, a cute little version of wifey."
Just imagining it melted his heart, but he would have to wait several more months. The anticipation made him feel strangely excited.
"So have you thought of a name yet?" Ava continued, while serving more food to Yasmine and others. She enjoyed fussing over them.
"Hmm, not yet, we have plenty of time," he replied. He didn't want to rush such an important choice.
It would be better to reach godhood as soon as possible and before his child is born; if they can reach the higher being level, that would be even better. The responsibility weighed on him.
They can reach godhood, but higher being might be tough. Still, he was determined.
"We should do some additional shopping of various things since we will be moving," Ava muttered unconsciously. Her mind had already jumped to practical matters.
"Hah! I knew it, you have already made up your mind too. I will start preparing for departing in a week!" Gunter said happily. He finished eating quickly and excitedly left.
Ava shook her head; he is so old yet acts like a child all the time. Maybe it was his responsibilities that made him be so serious at all times before.
Of course, she preferred this, and a smile appeared on her face. His childishness warmed her heart.
They began to discuss; aside from their living arrangements, Ava wanted to buy various things such as decorations, toys for her grandchild. She already pictured the child playing with them.
The atmosphere was joyous; the rest of the women dreamed of the day they too would have Vritra's child. The thought filled them with gentle longing.
There were still seven days and nothing really to do, so they all just planned to enjoy. It felt like a short vacation before a long journey.
Roaming the planet together, visiting places they hadn't before outside the continent.
Even going back to the Dunshire Kingdom, Vritra, Vanessa, Fiona and Diana felt nostalgic. Old memories surfaced with every familiar street.
The goddess remembered her past, how she was revered here, how she used to take pride in it and had no ambition of getting stronger. The contrast with her present self was striking.

chapters.title: Chapter 871 The Headmaster
paragraphs: Ten people entered a large castle, that seemed as if pulled straight out from Hogwarts. The architecture was impressive, with towering spires and intricate stonework that spoke of ancient power and knowledge.

It was bustling with crowd, many gathered here and there while discussing something in hushed, urgent tones. The atmosphere was charged with an intensity that only came from serious research and breakthrough discoveries.
They all were madly studying the glyphs, scribbling notes and comparing theories with fervent energy.
Vritra walked leisurely in the castle, his presence commanding despite his casual demeanor, and asked someone: "Where is the grandmaster?"
"Uh you can find him at the top floor, that belong solely to the headmaster." The other person replied absent mindedly, while writing something, barely sparing a glance at the newcomers.
"Okay thanks." Nodding, the ten continued forward, drawing some curious glances from the scholars they passed.
"H- Huh? Who was that?" only now did the man noticed it, his mind finally registering what his eyes had seen, but then he shrugged and returned to his work, dismissing the strange interruption.
Before long, Vritra and the other nine had arrived on the top floor, it was locked by some magical locks that glowed with faint runic patterns.
Shitless stepped forward and knocked with measured force, asking: "Is grandmaster inside?" His knuckles rapped against the heavy wooden door.

But no response came, only the echo of his knock returned. He tried a couple more times then simply tore the door apart as if paper, the solid wood crumbling under his strength like it was made of parchment.
They stepped inside and found the entire floor to be a mess, chaos and disorder everywhere, which they had all expected.
After all such crazy people goes mad in their experiments, losing themselves to their research.

But instead of glyphs and paper scattered about, the whole floor was covered by empty wine bottles and food plates which created a stench that made several of them grimace. The smell was overwhelming—a mixture of alcohol, rotting food, and neglect.

"..." they looked around carefully, their eyes scanning the disarray, and saw a thin man lying on the floor, he was clearly drunk, his body unmoving except for the faint rise and fall of his breathing.
His robe was in complete disarray, torn and stained with various substances, and his beard over a metre long, spread over his body like a blanket that he had fashioned into a makeshift covering.

"This is the headmaster? Did he really go mad?" Vritra frowned deeply, his disappointment evident, and gestured for Onest or Shitless to wake him up. Neither looked particularly enthusiastic about the task.
The two quarrelled for a bit, both reluctant to touch the drunk man, finally Onest slapped the headmaster lightly but didn't succeed in rousing him. The man merely groaned and rolled over.
He picked up a half filled wine bottle and poured the content down on his face without hesitation, watching to see if it would have the desired effect.

"Aaaaaah Flood!! F- FLOOD! RUN!" The man suddenly woke up with a start, crying out in dread and panic, thrashing about. But then he noticed that the flood seemed to be of his favourite wine, the expensive kind he savored.
So he relaxed and licked lips, savoring the taste, then his eyes fell over the women standing away from him, their forms barely visible in the dim lighting of the chamber.
"H- Heaven? Am I in heaven?! Haha fairies, come to me..." laughing like a madman, his sanity clearly questionable, he ran towards them with open arms and unrealistic expectations.
BANG
But was tossed back upon receiving a kick to his belly delivered with casual strength, vomiting out a mixture of various things onto the floor. His body flew backward, colliding with the stone wall.
That seemed to sober him up somewhat, the shock of impact cutting through his drunken haze.
"Ughh W- Who are y- you people?" he asked with a terrified look, finally realizing that these were not ordinary visitors. His eyes darted between them, assessing the danger.

The group leaked a bit of their auras, which scared the headmaster into stupification, his entire body freezing in fear. The raw power they exuded was suffocating, pressing down on him like a physical weight.
Vritra didn't want to waste any time on pleasantries or negotiations, so he asked Psyche to just search his memories. He had patience for many things, but not for unnecessary delays.
"Yes master." Psyche appeared in her usual ethereal form and immediately got to work, her hands glowing as she extracted all his memory. The process was thorough and invasive, leaving nothing hidden.
And Vritra also got the memories at the same time through their connection, experiencing everything the man had experienced.

He shook his head slowly, disappointed, and explained to others: "This guy is just a fraud, just got lucky upon finding a special inheritance left behind by Roderick Mecha, whose only condition was to create RMS- Roderick Mecha Squad. And spread these glyphs to all over the planet." His tone was matter-of-fact, devoid of emotion.
So the upgrade came from Roderick himself while this guy got lucky and was enjoying his life here, living off the work of a man long dead.
"This is a dead end too?" Teresa asked, frustration creeping into her voice. They had followed so many leads, only to find disappointment again.

"But why would Roderick try to spread his glyphs all over the planet? It certainly won't be for the good of the people." Yennefer voiced her opinion, her sharp mind already working through the implications. She knew that such elaborate plans always had darker purposes.

"Yea, he certainly had some shady plan, even after so many years of leaving this planet he arranged for these glyphs to spread everywhere." Maeve said, thinking hard about his plans and motivations. The complexity of it all suggested a master strategist at work.

"The inheritance is present below this castle, this place is more of a magical seal that Roderick had arranged, let's go and check that inheritance." Vritra decided, his tone brooking no argument. There had to be more here, something substantial.

After they all nodded in agreement, with a snap, Yennefer sent everyone in the castle outside, clearing the area to prevent collateral damage. The spell was executed flawlessly, the crowd vanishing in an instant.

And then Yasmine touched the wall which instantly made it explode in a shower of stone and dust. The power in her touch was casual but devastating, the barrier between them and the underground crumbling like paper.

A shield created by Teresa's wall appeared around them, protecting them even from the wild winds created by the explosion. The magical barrier shimmered with golden light, keeping them safe in the eye of the storm.

Before long, the ten were underground walking along a long cave system, the path leading them deeper into the earth. Shitless dragged the headmaster who was pretending to be dead, his body limp, though occasionally his eyes would flicker open.

Despite being level 7 demi gods, they were still being careful, that Roderick guy was too cunning to trust, too strategic to overlook. They had learned enough from the headmaster's memories to know that Roderick left nothing to chance.

"But why would Roderick try to spread his glyphs all over the planet?
It certainly won't be for the good of the people." Yennefer voiced her opinion, her sharp mind already working through the implications.
She knew that such elaborate plans always had darker purposes.
"Yea, he certainly had some shady plan, even after so many years of leaving this planet he arranged for these glyphs to spread everywhere." Maeve said, thinking hard about his plans and motivations.
The complexity of it all suggested a master strategist at work.
"The inheritance is present below this castle, this place is more of a magical seal that Roderick had arranged, let's go and check that inheritance." Vritra decided, his tone brooking no argument.
There had to be more here, something substantial.
After they all nodded in agreement, with a snap, Yennefer sent everyone in the castle outside, clearing the area to prevent collateral damage.
The spell was executed flawlessly, the crowd vanishing in an instant.
And then Yasmine touched the wall which instantly made it explode in a shower of stone and dust.
The power in her touch was casual but devastating, the barrier between them and the underground crumbling like paper.
A shield created by Teresa's wall appeared around them, protecting them even from the wild winds created by the explosion.
The magical barrier shimmered with golden light, keeping them safe in the eye of the storm.
Before long, the ten were underground walking along a long cave system, the path leading them deeper into the earth.
Shitless dragged the headmaster who was pretending to be dead, his body limp, though occasionally his eyes would flicker open.
Despite being level 7 demi gods, they were still being careful, that Roderick guy was too cunning to trust, too strategic to overlook.
They had learned enough from the headmaster's memories to know that Roderick left nothing to chance.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 872 Roderick's Inheritance
paragraphs: Soon they appeared before a wall, a smooth stone surface that looked absolutely ordinary at first glance, but radiated faint magical signatures.

"Y- You can go ahead, if you break the wall the whole inheritance will explode." The headmaster, finally finding a way to survive quickly spoke, his voice gaining confidence now that he had information they needed. His mind was already calculating how to use this leverage.

"And how do we open it then?" Shitless asked, his feet resting over the headmaster's head in a casual but threatening manner. The pressure was enough to remind the man exactly who held the power here.

"O- Only I can open it so you better b- behave, without me, you can do nothing." The headmaster wanted to threaten them more, but was afraid. His bravado was thin, easily pierced by the weight of his feet pressing down.
He hated all these people so much, they came to ruin his perfect life here, his comfortable existence funded by Roderick's legacy.
After a moment he made his mind, deciding on a course of action, after making them beg to open the door, he would then use the traps inside to kill them all. It was the only way to regain control.
But maybe he can let a woman or two live...
A faint grin appeared on his face upon thinking this, he will take his revenge. The fantasy kept him calm, giving him false hope.
"..." Teresa looked at the door which looked like a normal cave wall, then back at the headmaster who looked back with arrogance, his confidence growing by the second.
"I can open it." She said simply, her voice devoid of emotion.
Vritra smiled, proud of his wife, in such matters she was the brain of their family, a peerless talent at strategy and lateral thinking, probably even higher than Roderick himself in her abilities.
Then under their gaze, she waved her hand and the headmaster's screams filled the cave, echoing off the stone walls.
An eye floated out from his skull, a piece of bone from his finger, ten centimetres of his skin and one litre of blood. The extraction was precise and surgical, calculated perfectly.

'Er... did I corrupt her too much? She used to be so kind.' Vritra scratched his cheek as he watched her begin without even a change of expression. The method was brutal, efficient, and completely unlike the Teresa he had first met.
The headmaster was left screaming as within moments the door actually opened, his blood and sacrifice unlocking what greed and position could not.
"I- Impossible!!" the pain disappeared for a moment as he shouted in bafflement, his mind struggling to comprehend what had just occurred.
"Let's go." Teresa said, smiling sweetly at her husband, taking his head she led them inside as if she hadn't just extracted parts of a man's body.
Headmaster tried to activate the traps that he had studied and memorized before but Teresa had completely stolen the controls, his desperate attempts yielding nothing but failure.
Finally, he began to despair, realizing that his grand plans had crumbled to dust.
'So this is how I die, I didn't even do anything wrong...' he sobbed internally, just enjoying his position shouldn't be a crime, right? His self-deception was almost admirable in its commitment.
Just small crimes like killing some people, abducting some women but nothing too big. Nothing that should warrant this kind of punishment, surely.
"Husband, the inheritance is inside this chamber." Teresa pointed towards a chamber made of white tiles, perfectly pristine and glowing with faint magical runes.
Shitless threw the headmaster inside without ceremony, and instantly thousands of glyphs fell over him, bombarding his body from all directions simultaneously.
As expected, Roderick had prepared, he knew the headmaster wouldn't come there twice. Such contingencies were typical of his thorough planning.
But he probably hadn't expected such powerful demi gods to appear on this planet so soon, to arrive at his carefully laid plans before the proper time.
Vritra stepped inside carefully, and was instantly bombarded with thousands of glyphs that descended upon him like a swarm of locusts.
Yet they all paused in space and time as Yennefer waved a finger towards them, freezing them mid-descent with casual grace.

Vritra stopped before a mirror, it was over seven feet tall and didn't seem out of ordinary at first glance, yet this was the only thing present here. Everything else was just glyphs and magical constructs, but this mirror stood alone.
"Are you sure there is nothing else?" Vritra asked, turning back to Teresa, his instincts telling him something was amiss.
"Yes husband, I have already taken over this inheritance grou-" but suddenly her speech was cut off and eyes widened in surprise and alarm.
Noticing something amiss, Vritra instantly turned to look at the mirror and saw a face of gold appear, materializing from within its surface.
It released bright light, impossibly bright, the gaze bored into his eyes as Vritra suddenly felt as if his mind was struck with a hammer. The impact was immediate and devastating.
The world went dark, consciousness slipping away, he found himself in the soul form, appearing in front of the face made of gold that now seemed impossibly large and detailed.
"Roderick?" Vritra mumbled in surprised, recognizing the features, it was all too sudden. The transition had happened in mere moments.
But he got no time as the face opened its mouth and out drifted golden souls, all being a part of a single soul entity. They swirled around him like a vortex of power.
'Is it trying to take over my body?' Vritra frowned, assessing the threat level carefully.
By his intervention, Roderick's plan had certainly been messed up a little, but this soul seemed to be making things correct, adapting to the new circumstances.
Originally, this inheritance wasn't supposed to be discovered now, it should only had been discovered when the fated one reached level 2 demi god. The timing was crucial to the plan.
By that time, the whole planet would be taken over by RMS, and this event would have kickstarted his plans perfectly.
Roderick's plan were foolproof, designed with meticulous care, but this planet had become an anomaly, the leveling up becoming too absurd and too fast.
The soul face left behind possessed certain intelligence and had long sensed something was wrong. The accelerated timeline had triggered its failsafes.
Feeling that Vritra was the strongest, it targeted him, and if his body is overtaken, the plan will work perfect- no even better than before, adapted to the new reality.
The countless golden souls struck Vritra's soul body, slowly trying to corrupt him, to merge with him and take control.
Vritra on the other hand was completely calm, unfazed by the assault, he observed the place around him and was impressed by the craftsmanship.
'Roderick really planned this well, such a good guy, I will thank him when we meet for leaving such a good gift.' The irony wasn't lost on him that he was being attacked by a plan meant to help him.
He smiled and then his soul body transformed into a giant vortex, rotating with tremendous speed, and then [Suck! Suck! Suck!] was activated, consuming everything in its path.
Thanks for reading... adios

chapters.title: Chapter 873 Last day on Zoratian Planet
paragraphs: [Suck! Suck! Suck! Activated!]

As the vortex opened, it began to devour all the golden fragments with increasing speed and power, even affecting the golden face itself. The pull was irresistible, drawing everything into its center with relentless force.
The consciousness residing in this space was shocked as it began to lose control, its grip on the spiritual realm slipping away with each fragment consumed.
From the beginning it was meant to trap demi gods under level 4, a safeguard designed for weaker beings.

Vritra felt his soul strengthening the more he devoured, growing more powerful with each piece of golden essence absorbed, even the mysterious space began to crumble and got absorbed into his being. The sensation was exhilarating, each fragment adding to his power.
The golden face tried to use all sorts of methods to resist, attempting countless strategies, but how can it match a level 7 demi god? The gap in power was simply too vast to overcome.
Before long, Vritra's soul remained alone into emptiness, the last traces of the golden consciousness fading away completely.
Not only has his soul strengthened after absorbing all that accumulated power, but he had obtained pieces of memories, fragments of a mind far greater than his own.
Roderick's memories.

But first, Vritra returned to his body with a sudden gasp, finding that the cave had started to shatter around him, cracks spreading rapidly across the stone walls. The entire structure was collapsing inward.
With a thought, they all teleported outside before it could collapse completely, the cave imploding behind them moments after they vanished.
"What happened, husband?" Yennefer asked worriedly, stepping closer to him, for a few moments his body had gone completely still and unresponsive.
His soul had disappeared from their senses.

"It was a trap setup by Roderick for the heroes of this planet which should have been triggered once the new glyphs had been spread all over the world." Vritra said, breathing steadily, the memories weren't too clear but he had obtained enough information to understand the basics.
"Is there something wrong with the new glyphs?" Teresa asked, she had observed them carefully and didn't find anything overtly wrong with their structure.

"Not directly, but it draws some sort of external energy, that Roderick certainly has some grand ambitions." Vritra replied, his mind still processing the memories he had absorbed, then with a smile he added:

"But I was able to gain his location, he is currently present in some place called Crooked palace, very far away from here." The coordinates were clear in his mind now, imprinted from Roderick's own knowledge.
Once they are close, he would easily be able to locate Roderick and confront him directly.
While discussing, the group didn't linger in that location and left the kingdom, which was now in an uproar as the glyphs suddenly vanished.
Vritra wasn't exactly sure about Roderick's complete plan but knew he was planning to use these glyphs as a crucial component for it.

Since he was leaving this planet anyway, he decided to clean it up one last time, removing the potential threat before departing, and so with a thought, all the new glyphs disappeared at the same time across the entire planet.
People who were using those glyphs were baffled by the sudden loss, and so the chaos spread throughout the continent.
Without caring about any of it, once they were done with their business, the group returned to their home, now nearly a day remained before they have to leave this place forever.
"Sir Shitless, you should go ahead and check out how that place is." As they landed in the Yate realm, Vritra turned and spoke seriously, his tone leaving no room for argument.
"Already? What am I going to do for a whole day? What if I get caught?" the monk took a step back, clearly regretting his earlier volunteer decision back then. His face showed his uncertainty.

"Don't you trust your owner- I mean, pet's words? He will keep you safe, and we would be living there from now on, how could a single day be dangerous?" Vritra patted his shoulder reassuringly and asked Divine in his mind to send the monk to the higher being realm safely.
"...fine" sighing heavily, the monk resigned to his fate, accepting the inevitable.
He dejectedly followed them back regardless of his protests.
The Yate realm was crowded with people, bustling with activity and excitement, Gunter had organised a big event and the news of them leaving soon had already spread throughout the kingdom.
Gunter had appointed someone as the next head of the Yate family, someone he trusted enough with the entire kingdom's future.
The event was yet to begin but the preparations were complete, everything arranged perfectly.
The ten headed directly into the Yate palace where Ava and Gunter were waiting for them, both in a good mood, their faces bright with anticipation.

"Son, you are back! How do you like the party outside? We can depart tomorrow, all the big people of this continent will be coming soon." Gunter spoke excitedly, his voice filled with enthusiasm, beside him rested a large bag packed with their belongings.
"It's good, but have you really made your mind to go with us?" Vritra asked in a solemn tone, wanting to confirm their decision one final time.
"Yes." Ava answered firmly without hesitation, they had a talk about it thoroughly and there really was no reason to stay here anymore.
This authority and position could be gained again somewhere else, but the two didn't want to separate from their child for any reason.
"Okay then, I need to do something, I will be back in a minute." After speaking, he started walking away and gestured for Shitless to follow him.
SIGH
Shitless silently followed after him and the two paused near the house of darkness where Bullo was present, a portal had already appeared before it, shimmering with ethereal energy.
"But what am I even going to do there?" Monk Shitless asked desperately, still hoping to find a way out.
"You are a monk, just do that, spread kindness into the world." Vritra answered simply, not everyone is lucky enough to have friends like this, taking the front themselves.
Willingly, shielding them from harm.
"But-"
With a kick from Bullo, Shitless was thrown into the portal before he could speak anything, his protests cut short.
"And its done." As the portal closed behind the monk, Vritra looked at Bullo and asked seriously:
"What did Roderick plan to do? You must be aware right?" The question was directed at Divine, communicating through Bullo.
"Yes I know." Divine's voice sounded in his mind, as he explained without hiding anything, revealing the complete truth:
"Roderick is close to reaching the higher being level, he planned to refine the fate of everyone here and refine the planet itself to create a pill that would grant him that level."
"Oh! Why was he waiting for the heroes to appear and reach the 2nd or 3rd level? And what's up with the glyphs?" Vritra continued with his questions, needing to understand the full scope of the plan.
He can make some guesses about few things but it was better to get the whole information from Divine directly.

"You know, with each game the planet itself evolves, the planet and people have massive gains so he needed to wait for that evolution to complete. As for those glyphs, with them its easier to control everything here." Divine answered both the questions patiently, as if teaching a student.
"I see, so our action today disrupted his plan?" Vritra asked, wanting confirmation of their impact.
"Indeed, but he must have backups, or maybe this was merely a backup plan itself."
"Hmm We will proceed tomorrow as planned." After nodding in understanding, Vritra turned and walked back towards the palace, his expression contemplative.
Divine remained there for a bit longer and then disappeared; how can he let his pet be alone in that desolate place? He would ensure Shitless's safety personally.
Vritra found his wives gathered together, Ava talking with some women, the guests of the event while Gunter was introducing the new family head to important figures in the kingdom.

It was a middle aged man who had worked under Gunter for many years and was already at the lord rank, he mostly remained hidden in the shadows and was responsible for plannings and eliminations secretly.
Vritra walked over and was greeted by everyone present there respectfully, they all knew exactly how powerful he was, all being very respectful and courteous.
After making small talks with various nobles, Vritra looked around at the grand hall that was prepared for this event, it was truly magnificent in every way.

A lost must be spent, even the chairs and tables for guests were made of rare metals and precious materials, each so expensive that small kingdoms would keep them hidden in their treasury. The craftsmanship was exceptional.
Yate family didn't lack richness or resources of any kind.
All the people were shocked hearing that Gunter was leaving to follow his son to another realm.
Of course some were happy about the change, some were not, and just like that the event continued throughout the day.
After talking with some guests and nobles, Vritra separated from them and sat down away from the crowd, observing the gathering.
All people were putting such fake attitudes and forced smiles, many were hoping he would help them before going, hoping to alleviate their families to higher status.
Or maybe leave some treasure for them, after all Teresa is his wife and she had created countless treasures.
Just one of her creations would become their family's heirloom for generations.
All sorts of families and organizations wanted a piece, hoping to gain something.
Vritra let Gunter deal with them all, he was used to such political games.
The people from Teresa's family had also arrived, her grandfather, and brother were sad by the news and rich too.
They all came to meet her one last time, who knows if they can meet each other again or not.
One by one, his wives arrived beside him throughout the evening, they all exhausted from talking with these fawning ladies who wouldn't leave them alone.
Some were so brazen that they directly showed their desire to become Vritra's wife or concubine or even a maid in his household.
But they were all turned down politely but firmly.
Just like that time passed slowly, soon guests gave up their attempts and began to simply enjoy the event and its festivities.
Vritra along with his whole family sat together as they ate the last meal on the Zoratian planet, and it was really delicious, prepared by master chefs.
The event ended, and the crowd left the palace gradually as night fell.
The remaining day, they all spent together, just roaming in the Yate realm, enjoying each other's company.
Ava did some shopping with the other women, all the people of the realm came to respectfully greet them as they passed, their lives had been really great in this realm and they would miss it.

The public was very sad that they were leaving, and worried about how their lives forward would be without Gunter's guidance, but knew that Gunter must have made proper arrangements for the transition.
And just like that the day passed into evening, at night, no one slept and sat together on the palace balcony, staring at the starry sky above them.
Talking about the unknown future and some small plans for what was to come, the atmosphere was joyous while also a bit ambiguous and melancholic at the same time.
Vritra gazed at Yasmine affectionately, taking her head and resting it against his shoulder, soon they would be moving to a new home where their child would be born.
But first would come the godhood, the ascension that awaited them all.
Thanks for reading... adios
