"You know, with each game the planet itself evolves, the planet and people have massive gains so he needed to wait for that evolution to complete.
As for those glyphs, with them its easier to control everything here." Divine answered both the questions patiently, as if teaching a student.
"I see, so our action today disrupted his plan?" Vritra asked, wanting confirmation of their impact.
"Indeed, but he must have backups, or maybe this was merely a backup plan itself."
"Hmm We will proceed tomorrow as planned." After nodding in understanding, Vritra turned and walked back towards the palace, his expression contemplative.
Divine remained there for a bit longer and then disappeared; how can he let his pet be alone in that desolate place?
He would ensure Shitless's safety personally.
Vritra found his wives gathered together, Ava talking with some women, the guests of the event while Gunter was introducing the new family head to important figures in the kingdom.

It was a middle aged man who had worked under Gunter for many years and was already at the lord rank, he mostly remained hidden in the shadows and was responsible for plannings and eliminations secretly.
Vritra walked over and was greeted by everyone present there respectfully, they all knew exactly how powerful he was, all being very respectful and courteous.
After making small talks with various nobles, Vritra looked around at the grand hall that was prepared for this event, it was truly magnificent in every way.
A lost must be spent, even the chairs and tables for guests were made of rare metals and precious materials, each so expensive that small kingdoms would keep them hidden in their treasury.
The craftsmanship was exceptional.
Yate family didn't lack richness or resources of any kind.
All the people were shocked hearing that Gunter was leaving to follow his son to another realm.
Of course some were happy about the change, some were not, and just like that the event continued throughout the day.
After talking with some guests and nobles, Vritra separated from them and sat down away from the crowd, observing the gathering.
All people were putting such fake attitudes and forced smiles, many were hoping he would help them before going, hoping to alleviate their families to higher status.
Or maybe leave some treasure for them, after all Teresa is his wife and she had created countless treasures.
Just one of her creations would become their family's heirloom for generations.
All sorts of families and organizations wanted a piece, hoping to gain something.
Vritra let Gunter deal with them all, he was used to such political games.
The people from Teresa's family had also arrived, her grandfather, and brother were sad by the news and rich too.
They all came to meet her one last time, who knows if they can meet each other again or not.
One by one, his wives arrived beside him throughout the evening, they all exhausted from talking with these fawning ladies who wouldn't leave them alone.
Some were so brazen that they directly showed their desire to become Vritra's wife or concubine or even a maid in his household.
But they were all turned down politely but firmly.
Just like that time passed slowly, soon guests gave up their attempts and began to simply enjoy the event and its festivities.
Vritra along with his whole family sat together as they ate the last meal on the Zoratian planet, and it was really delicious, prepared by master chefs.
The event ended, and the crowd left the palace gradually as night fell.
The remaining day, they all spent together, just roaming in the Yate realm, enjoying each other's company.
Ava did some shopping with the other women, all the people of the realm came to respectfully greet them as they passed, their lives had been really great in this realm and they would miss it.

The public was very sad that they were leaving, and worried about how their lives forward would be without Gunter's guidance, but knew that Gunter must have made proper arrangements for the transition.
And just like that the day passed into evening, at night, no one slept and sat together on the palace balcony, staring at the starry sky above them.
Talking about the unknown future and some small plans for what was to come, the atmosphere was joyous while also a bit ambiguous and melancholic at the same time.
Vritra gazed at Yasmine affectionately, taking her head and resting it against his shoulder, soon they would be moving to a new home where their child would be born.
But first would come the godhood, the ascension that awaited them all.
Thanks for reading... adios

chapters.title: Chapter 874 Scumbag
paragraphs: In a realm where thousands of higher beings resided, existing in a state that transcended normal comprehension.
Where the temperature and other environmental effects differed every few kilometres, creating microclimates of wildly varying conditions.
All sorts of houses could be seen scattered across the landscape, some made of wood resembling old times and primitive construction.

Some tall and so futuristic even earth can't develop them for a few centuries, their design defying conventional architecture, while some even looked like ant caves carved into crystalline structures.
Since passage of time means little to the higher beings, all of them easily get bored, always needing something new and exciting to occupy their eternal existence.

Which is where the gods and those games fill in, it was exactly from these games that many higher beings were impressed and took houses from, or many other things, copying designs they found entertaining.
These games always offer something new and fun, watching the survival of those weak had brought them pleasure in ways that mundane existence could never provide.
In every century or two, the games were organised and played for all higher beings to watch, becoming grand events.
Otherwise they would just pass time in this realm or go out to explore different realms, though most higher beings had gotten too lazy, controlled by desires and comfort.
They would just stay in the realm all the time, never venturing far from their homes.
Their strength was also lower than the other higher beings who would fight or explore other realms, their constant indolence weakening them over time.

The higher beings can't die because of the passage of time, which is probably why they are always at war with other entities such as Crooked, Asuras, the Witches and others. Death came only through combat or external forces.
Just among them, there are also some factions such as the Law Holders, the Vespera family, which Evelyn is a part of, wielding significant influence.
There is also the Garissa family, which has sort of underworld among higher beings, controlling illicit activities.
Aside from these two top families, there were also many other groups and organizations, some formed to oppose the Vespera family, some formed purely for fun and companionship.
Two such major organizations were Arson Lords and Holy Righteous Heresy, both possessing high strength and considerable resources.
Before arriving in the higher being's realm, Vritra and the others received a large amount of information from the Divine, preparing them for what was to come.
For now, they would just stay here for some time since the current goal was becoming gods themselves.
Divine did whatever he could to prepare them and left the rest to Evelyn who had made arrangements on her own, using her family connections.
In an empty area, where the ground was covered by tiny plants that could be peerless treasures for even demi gods, valuable beyond measure.
It suddenly got covered by a looming shadow, blocking out the light, then something large, covered by dark flames slowly descended from the sky.
Such a spectacle pulled the attention of surrounding bored higher beings, those whose houses were present nearby, desperate for any distraction.
The houses some were even up in the sky or hidden in secret realms they had created in their areas, invisible to the untrained eye.
"Oh, they are back?!"
Someone exclaimed with genuine surprise, as the house of darkness finally and safely landed on the ground, occupying a big area. The landing was controlled and precise despite the massive size.
But still had a large area around the house, space that could be used for various purposes.
These areas had been allotted or won by the higher beings, from outside it won't look much, appearing ordinary and unremarkable.
But they can easily make it infinitely big or as small as a needle tip, manipulating space was a minor thing for them after all, a basic application of their power.
The nearby people all looked with interest at the house of darkness, this area had been empty for quite some time now, unused and unclaimed.
Many even had their eyes set on it, hungry for its acquisition, but as a rule set by the Vespera family, established long ago.
They can't usurp it unless it remains empty for a certain period of time or is won through some bets or other means of competition.
So, they sighed seeing the previous resident return, their hopes dashed, but what surprised them even more was the condition of the house itself.
It belonged to a powerful warrior from the Vespera family, but that guy was said to be a mole and was long disposed of, eliminated for his treachery.
This house was not ordinary either, that person had exhausted nearly all his fortune into creating it and barely succeeded, pushing himself to the limit.
The result being exceptional and awe-inspiring in its construction.
The house of darkness, which Vritra had obtained from the world bank had been nerfed since staying in the outer space, its power diminished by the journey.
But as soon as it landed, root like arms thrusted into the ground with force, as the house firmly took its place, establishing dominance over the area.

It suddenly seemed to possess a bit of consciousness, awakening to its new surroundings, the black flames became terrifyingly powerful that would keep even other higher beings away, creating a barrier of pure menace.
The stone guards which previously had only been at the level of lords also rapidly returned to their peak strength, their power surging back.
Most of them possessed the strength of demi gods, all of level 10, there were even some god level protectors, ancient constructs of tremendous power.
The vision of all the peering higher beings was instantly blocked by the house of darkness, as it seemed to grow bigger by several times, expanding to demonstrate its authority.
Inside the house, Vritra, his wives, Onest, Gunter and Ava were all sitting in a hall, gathered together.
They all sensed the changes happening around them, the aura of the house had suddenly spiked to the roof, becoming almost overwhelming.
"It is time..." Divine's voice sounded through the space, and everyone looked at the table where an insect was present, small but powerful.
"But before that, there is one more thing you all should know."
"What is it now?" Vritra had gotten tired upon hearing the constant buzzing of this bug, the irritating sound wearing on his patience, he really wanted to spray some anti bug spray at it.
'I wonder if Divine will die.' He wondered idly and decided to try it later when he had the opportunity.

"I had killed the higher beings who used to live in this space, so you all will be taking over their identities." Divine said, his tone matter-of-fact, after seeing them all nod he continued with the explanation:
"The master of the house were eight people, a man, his three wives, three daughters and his mother-"
Onest couldn't help but interrupt in the middle, curious: "Then what about the rest of us? Do we just hide inside the house?"
"No no, let me finish first." Divine didn't mind the interruption and again started explaining patiently.

"The names or appearances doesn't mean much so you can just use your original ones since Evelyn will take care of it and provide the necessary documentation. Now, the man of the house was a rather bad person, a playboy and cruel to his family-"
"What? This happen even in the higher beings?" Onest asked incredulously, shocked by this revelation.
Isn't that the story of normal people in lower realms?

"Haha these higher beings sometimes have it rougher than other people, they are created in a way that even if they are cowardly and hide, they always attract trouble and fights regardless." Divine replied with a laugh, finding amusement in the question.
"Anyway, the stories of his cruelty are pretty popular and he got punished several times by the Law Holders for his actions."
Vritra frowned upon hearing this but said nothing, remaining silent, the role sounded easy to play though once he understood what was expected.
And just as expected, Divine spoke: "Let's now describe the roles for each of you."
"Vritra is a scumbag-" Divine spoke in a gloating tone, clearly enjoying himself, who would have thought he can openly badmouth him like this.
But seeing Vritra ready to squish him into a smear and the surrounding women glaring daggers at the insect, even his sisters joining in the glare, he quickly changed his wordings to be safer.
"Vritra is the scumbag... 'character', the mother will be..." Divine paused and looked at the surrounding people, considering options.
Ava piped up hearing this, her heart racing, of course this role was tailor made for her, if not her then who else could be a mother to all of them-
"It will be Vanessa." But Divine's words quickly poured cold water on her hopes and expectations.
She didn't interrupt, only sighing in her heart, accepting the assignment without complaint.
"As for the three wives, they will be Yasmine, Yennefer and Diana. While the daughters are Fiona, Maeve and Teresa." Divine added, laying out the complete structure.
Listening to these words, it almost felt as if they were about to play some big roleplay game, some kind of elaborate performance.
Yasmine, Yennefer and Diana didn't feel any difference since their status remained the same, their roles unchanged in essence.
Vanessa too didn't feel much about it, accepting her new position with grace.
But Fiona, Maeve and Teresa glanced at each other, speechlessly and with some uncertainty. Were they now going to be daughters to their husband? The implications seemed strange.
Thanks for reading... adios

chapters.title: Chapter 875 Green Pickle
paragraphs: But on second thought, the three women couldn't help but have some improper thoughts, their minds wandering to interesting scenarios.
So, they didn't object either, they wouldn't mind playing that role, finding it actually somewhat appealing.
Then Divine looked at Onest: "You will be a servant, doing gardening or basic cleaning, general maintenance."
"Uh... Okay." Onest wanted to refute but in the end he just nodded reluctantly, telling himself this was just acting after all, temporary.
Still he wanted Shitless to have such a role as well, misery loving company, but where was that Baldy?
"As for you two, you will still be a couple, here as attendants to these people." Divine finally finished his explanations.
The main roles mattered the more for their cover story, the rest? Other higher beings wouldn't even care one bit about any of them... in most cases, barely sparing them a glance.
"Alright that's settled then." Gunter spoke, nodding, not minding it at all.
He had been the ruler of Yate family, the strongest family on the Zoratian planet but now reduced to mere attendants? It was a strange demotion.
Gunter was instead happy about it, his heart light, a world so vast he could never have imagined has just opened up for him like a flower blooming.
All he wished to be a demi God, and see more of this world beyond his planet.
Ava nodded too, her expression peaceful.
"So, what are we all to do? Are there some characteristics we must follow or specific behaviours?" Yasmine asked, looking at the small bug with curiosity.

"Not much, the original mother dotted on his son too much, that's... still the same, no change needed. The three wives suffered because of their scumbag husband still they were pretty normal and lastly, the three daughters, they were rather meek." Divine answered, then adding with emphasis:
"Aside from Vritra, you all can remain true to your nature, he just need to be disrespectful, an arrogant fool, cursing anyone at the slightest thing, showing no respect."
"What happened with the original family? You killed them all?" Ava asked, her voice tinged with concern, unlike the others, she wasn't accustomed to bloodshed and violence.
So the thought of those pitiful women dying made her feel sad, weighing on her conscience.

"No, I sent those women far away from here, to a safe location far removed, while killing several dangerous people here instead." Divine replied, his tone practical, why would he kill such useful people indiscriminately?
Despite being pitiful, they are still higher beings, a thought from them could result in the end destruction of a planet or even deaths of gods, their power was not to be underestimated.
"That is all for now, stay careful and... enjoy!" Divine added, wrapping up the briefing.
Right away, the insect disappeared, vanishing from sight, praying for their safety from far away in his mind.
Vritra looked at his family, though he still felt unsure about the plan but this was the only way ahead they had available.
After slight discussions and practicing their roles a bit, running through scenarios, they finally decided to head outside.
Opening the door, Vritra was the first to step outside and instantly his body froze, his senses overwhelming.
Several gazes locked onto him, the moment he stepped out of the house, multiple eyes upon him.
These gazes didn't belong to the surrounding higher beings, instead came from far away, they couldn't even locate their source.
But almost instantly, Vritra calmed down as he walked into the lawn outside, hands resting over his waist in a casual pose.
They didn't die instantly, which already proved it wasn't as dangerous as his instincts initially screamed.
The others also felt the gazes as they walked out one by one, they weren't as calm as Vritra under the heavy gazes and pressure.
But no one found anything strange with their behaviour, the distant powerful beings even lost interest soon after, turning their attention elsewhere.
Some of the nearby higher beings looked sympathetically towards the frozen group, their expression pitying.
"What a beast, he is still the same. Look how terrified his family looks." One of the neighbours spoke, shaking his head disapprovingly.
They found nothing wrong with their appearance or their energy level, not even glancing at the servants, dismissing them as unimportant.
Vritra turned his head upon hearing it, looking directly at the green coloured neighbour with intensity.
A frown appeared on his face as he asked harshly: "What are you gawking at, you overgrown green turd?"
Cursing someone so much more powerful than himself, felt a bit risky but also exhilarating and fitting for his character.
"So what? I am not stepping in your area, what are you going to do about it?" the green pickle face like man retorted, trying to maintain his image in front of everyone watching.
Cursing someone so much more powerful than himself, felt a bit risky but also exhilarating and fitting for his character.
Appearance for the higher beings means little, they can change their forms easily and without limitation.
Mostly choose human like since it is better than most forms and with great usability and familiarity.
Still many higher beings would choose different appearance, some based on the games they see, some just experimenting with new forms.
The green pickle neighbour was one such example, he found this appearance very pretty to his eyes, so he hated when someone insulted it so directly.
But Vritra was too violent so he didn't dare start a real fight and even leaned back into his house, half closing the window defensively.
"Keep staring, green turd. Maybe you'll evolve." Vritra gave a mocking chuckle, dismissive and cold, and no longer paid him any attention.
He too didn't want to start a fight, not right now; this was a direct way to hell and complications.
"Where is Shitless though?" Vritra suddenly remembered suddenly, his mind shifting gears, he forgot to ask Divine about it specifically.
He wondered why they all always forget about Shitless, that shouldn't be normal right? It was strange and unsettling.
"D- Don't call me that or I will call the Law Holders!" the green pickle threatened desperately, his voice shaking, he had always hated Vritra with burning intensity.
The previous time Vritra was arrested by the Law Holders, it was precisely because green pickle silently observed and followed him for months and finally exposed him to authorities.
But the punishment was reduced thanks to his war achievements against the Crooked, his contributions earning him leniency.
Next time, I will get him punished for a very long time and save his family. The thought gave him some comfort and resolve.
Finally, his gaze passed over the group of women and he found their new appearances to be extremely beautiful, more beautiful than before somehow.
Then he glanced at himself, and felt that this form might not be appropriate for the situation but he had changed the form not long ago.
So according to the law, he can't change it for a few years, locked into this appearance.
Vritra ignored him completely, and looked to the other side, nearly all the neighbours were avoiding him, staying clear.
"Hey green turd, have you seen a bald guy around here? But even if you did, don't you dare tell me about his whereabouts!" Vritra said, looking arrogantly at the green man, testing him.
Just by a few exchanges, Vritra already understood his personality, grasping his nature.

"H- Hmph how dare you order me, of course I have seen that bald great monk. He is currently in the temple, I told you, what are you going to do? I am braver than you!" he said, glancing at the women who didn't even look at him, their eyes fixed ahead.
'They must think I am very brave, but are so afraid they can't even react, I will protect them!' a strong feeling rose in his heart, swelling with false pride.
Vritra clicked his tongue in disdain; there really are such pathetic and stupid people even among higher beings?
"This is natural, the Crooked are the impurities and bad luck driven out of their bodies, some are more purer while others are less purer like this green guy." Divine explained to him mentally.
He was also not exactly sure of Evelyn's exact plans, she had hastily changed everything because of her desires for him.
If nothing goes wrong, she will be here very soon to check on their progress.
The group however was surprised upon hearing about Shitless, he was in the temple? The revelation shocked them.
There is a temple even in such a place? There are religions too then? Or was it just an imitations of some planet they came across in their explorations?
These people sure likes bringing things that interests them, collecting and recreating them.
He is not again causing some big trouble, is he? They all were instantly filled with worry and dread, and regretting sending that evil monk here first without proper preparation.
"You go back inside, I will go check the temple." Vritra said decisively, his tone leaving no room for argument, if things went bad at least they can try to escape.
But if they all go, then it would be impossible to flee effectively. Even if Divine is powerful and can kill higher beings.
He surely can't fight them all on his own right? And even if there is Evelyn on their side, she too can't do it alone.
Her own fate is being controlled by her family, her capabilities are also limited by their restrictions.
"Okay." The women wanted to say something more, to protest, but playing according to their role, they only nodded obediently.
"Honey, be careful." Vanessa said, her voice warm, she didn't need to act for this concern.
"Yes, mom." Nodding, he watched them all go back into the house then turned and disappeared.
Only then did green pickle relaxed, finally putting down the round ball he was holding to call for help, his hands shaking slightly.
Vritra didn't use Null for travel, instead used his mastery over the space to teleport away, covering distance instantly.
As for finding the location of the temple, that wasn't difficult really, it could be seen from a long distance, visible from most points in the area.
It was white and pristine, was single floor yet so high and imposing, shaped like a pyramid and strange statues surrounding it, guardian figures.
Vritra didn't linger around and directly teleported to the entrance of the temple, instantly sensing the aura of the place with his power.
It was completely different from his own home area, it seemed to affect mind in some way, altering perception and consciousness.
Creating an illusion of relaxation and peace but in reality, filling it up with unknown vast memories, almost like getting filled with virus, contaminating the mind.
Thanks for reading...

Gunter was instead happy about it, his heart light, a world so vast he could never have imagined has just opened up for him like a flower blooming.
All he wished to be a demi God, and see more of this world beyond his planet.
Ava nodded too, her expression peaceful.
"So, what are we all to do?
Are there some characteristics we must follow or specific behaviours?" Yasmine asked, looking at the small bug with curiosity.
"Not much, the original mother dotted on his son too much, that's... still the same, no change needed.
The three wives suffered because of their scumbag husband still they were pretty normal and lastly, the three daughters, they were rather meek." Divine answered, then adding with emphasis:
"Aside from Vritra, you all can remain true to your nature, he just need to be disrespectful, an arrogant fool, cursing anyone at the slightest thing, showing no respect."
"What happened with the original family?
You killed them all?" Ava asked, her voice tinged with concern, unlike the others, she wasn't accustomed to bloodshed and violence.
So the thought of those pitiful women dying made her feel sad, weighing on her conscience.

"No, I sent those women far away from here, to a safe location far removed, while killing several dangerous people here instead." Divine replied, his tone practical, why would he kill such useful people indiscriminately?
Despite being pitiful, they are still higher beings, a thought from them could result in the end destruction of a planet or even deaths of gods, their power was not to be underestimated.
"That is all for now, stay careful and... enjoy!" Divine added, wrapping up the briefing.
Right away, the insect disappeared, vanishing from sight, praying for their safety from far away in his mind.
Vritra looked at his family, though he still felt unsure about the plan but this was the only way ahead they had available.
After slight discussions and practicing their roles a bit, running through scenarios, they finally decided to head outside.
Opening the door, Vritra was the first to step outside and instantly his body froze, his senses overwhelming.
Several gazes locked onto him, the moment he stepped out of the house, multiple eyes upon him.
These gazes didn't belong to the surrounding higher beings, instead came from far away, they couldn't even locate their source.
But almost instantly, Vritra calmed down as he walked into the lawn outside, hands resting over his waist in a casual pose.
They didn't die instantly, which already proved it wasn't as dangerous as his instincts initially screamed.
The others also felt the gazes as they walked out one by one, they weren't as calm as Vritra under the heavy gazes and pressure.
But no one found anything strange with their behaviour, the distant powerful beings even lost interest soon after, turning their attention elsewhere.
Some of the nearby higher beings looked sympathetically towards the frozen group, their expression pitying.
"What a beast, he is still the same.
Look how terrified his family looks." One of the neighbours spoke, shaking his head disapprovingly.
They found nothing wrong with their appearance or their energy level, not even glancing at the servants, dismissing them as unimportant.
Vritra turned his head upon hearing it, looking directly at the green coloured neighbour with intensity.
A frown appeared on his face as he asked harshly: "What are you gawking at, you overgrown green turd?"
Cursing someone so much more powerful than himself, felt a bit risky but also exhilarating and fitting for his character.
"So what?
I am not stepping in your area, what are you going to do about it?" the green pickle face like man retorted, trying to maintain his image in front of everyone watching.
Cursing someone so much more powerful than himself, felt a bit risky but also exhilarating and fitting for his character.
Appearance for the higher beings means little, they can change their forms easily and without limitation.
Mostly choose human like since it is better than most forms and with great usability and familiarity.
Still many higher beings would choose different appearance, some based on the games they see, some just experimenting with new forms.
The green pickle neighbour was one such example, he found this appearance very pretty to his eyes, so he hated when someone insulted it so directly.
But Vritra was too violent so he didn't dare start a real fight and even leaned back into his house, half closing the window defensively.
"Keep staring, green turd.
Maybe you'll evolve." Vritra gave a mocking chuckle, dismissive and cold, and no longer paid him any attention.
He too didn't want to start a fight, not right now; this was a direct way to hell and complications.
"Where is Shitless though?" Vritra suddenly remembered suddenly, his mind shifting gears, he forgot to ask Divine about it specifically.
He wondered why they all always forget about Shitless, that shouldn't be normal right?
It was strange and unsettling.
"D- Don't call me that or I will call the Law Holders!" the green pickle threatened desperately, his voice shaking, he had always hated Vritra with burning intensity.
The previous time Vritra was arrested by the Law Holders, it was precisely because green pickle silently observed and followed him for months and finally exposed him to authorities.
But the punishment was reduced thanks to his war achievements against the Crooked, his contributions earning him leniency.
Next time, I will get him punished for a very long time and save his family.
The thought gave him some comfort and resolve.
Finally, his gaze passed over the group of women and he found their new appearances to be extremely beautiful, more beautiful than before somehow.
Then he glanced at himself, and felt that this form might not be appropriate for the situation but he had changed the form not long ago.
So according to the law, he can't change it for a few years, locked into this appearance.
Vritra ignored him completely, and looked to the other side, nearly all the neighbours were avoiding him, staying clear.
"Hey green turd, have you seen a bald guy around here?
But even if you did, don't you dare tell me about his whereabouts!" Vritra said, looking arrogantly at the green man, testing him.
Just by a few exchanges, Vritra already understood his personality, grasping his nature.
"H- Hmph how dare you order me, of course I have seen that bald great monk.
He is currently in the temple, I told you, what are you going to do?
I am braver than you!" he said, glancing at the women who didn't even look at him, their eyes fixed ahead.
'They must think I am very brave, but are so afraid they can't even react, I will protect them!' a strong feeling rose in his heart, swelling with false pride.
Vritra clicked his tongue in disdain; there really are such pathetic and stupid people even among higher beings?
"This is natural, the Crooked are the impurities and bad luck driven out of their bodies, some are more purer while others are less purer like this green guy." Divine explained to him mentally.
He was also not exactly sure of Evelyn's exact plans, she had hastily changed everything because of her desires for him.
If nothing goes wrong, she will be here very soon to check on their progress.
The group however was surprised upon hearing about Shitless, he was in the temple?
The revelation shocked them.
There is a temple even in such a place?
There are religions too then?
Or was it just an imitations of some planet they came across in their explorations?
These people sure likes bringing things that interests them, collecting and recreating them.
He is not again causing some big trouble, is he?
They all were instantly filled with worry and dread, and regretting sending that evil monk here first without proper preparation.
"You go back inside, I will go check the temple." Vritra said decisively, his tone leaving no room for argument, if things went bad at least they can try to escape.
But if they all go, then it would be impossible to flee effectively.
Even if Divine is powerful and can kill higher beings.
He surely can't fight them all on his own right?
And even if there is Evelyn on their side, she too can't do it alone.
Her own fate is being controlled by her family, her capabilities are also limited by their restrictions.
"Okay." The women wanted to say something more, to protest, but playing according to their role, they only nodded obediently.
"Honey, be careful." Vanessa said, her voice warm, she didn't need to act for this concern.
"Yes, mom." Nodding, he watched them all go back into the house then turned and disappeared.
Only then did green pickle relaxed, finally putting down the round ball he was holding to call for help, his hands shaking slightly.
Vritra didn't use Null for travel, instead used his mastery over the space to teleport away, covering distance instantly.
As for finding the location of the temple, that wasn't difficult really, it could be seen from a long distance, visible from most points in the area.
It was white and pristine, was single floor yet so high and imposing, shaped like a pyramid and strange statues surrounding it, guardian figures.
Vritra didn't linger around and directly teleported to the entrance of the temple, instantly sensing the aura of the place with his power.
It was completely different from his own home area, it seemed to affect mind in some way, altering perception and consciousness.
Creating an illusion of relaxation and peace but in reality, filling it up with unknown vast memories, almost like getting filled with virus, contaminating the mind.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 876 Amitabha~
paragraphs: Vritra paused for a moment in front of the temple, his mind was suddenly overwhelmed by a mess of foreign sensations and memories.

Maybe it won't affect the higher beings much, their vast consciousness capable of filtering such intrusions, but it was too much for someone who is merely a demi god, the assault on his mind nearly staggering.
Soon however, the effects disappeared automatically, fading away as his will asserted dominance.
'What was that?' Vritra frowned deeply, was that sensation used on higher beings to subtly change them over time?
Or to keep weak people away from the temple's inner sanctum?
Whatever might be the case, Vritra was pulled out of his thoughts when he heard some chanting from inside, voices raised in unison.
"Love live the great Buddha!"
"Om mani padme hum!"
"Amitabha!"
The chants echoed through the stone walls, creating an almost hypnotic resonance.
Without waiting he rushed into the temple, climbing the long stairs since using his abilities might expose him and blow his cover.
A minute after Vritra had entered the temple, something under the grass moved and then Green pickle was revealed, crawling out from his hiding spot.
To save all seven of those pitiful women, he had once again resumed his operation to get Vritra punished for his crimes.
Of course, Vritra cannot yet sense that a higher being was following him so closely, tracking his movements.
Upon entering, Vritra found over thirty people who stood before a big stage, all gathered in the dim light of the temple.
They all wore white attires, almost looking like a cult member, rapidly chanting something in a language he didn't recognize.
But when his gaze shifted to the stage, he was even more surprised by what he saw.
The bald monk stood on the stage, his body trembling slightly, a white cloth wrapped around his body almost like a robe.

His palms pressed together in a prayer position and a forced smile on his face, clearly strained and unnatural... poor Shitless looked as if he was fighting for his life, struggling against invisible bonds.
He wanted to run away but couldn't move, so he just stood like a statue, frozen in place.
'Pitiful one, saveeee meeeeeee!' internally he was screaming, his mind desperately calling for rescue, while fearfully muttering:
"A- Amitabha~"
His voice wavering with barely concealed panic.
"Let's establish the buddha here, I will take his skin!" one of the guys suddenly spoke up, gesturing excitedly.
"That's not fair, haa fine I will take his eyes, I heard whichever direction the eyes of buddha see, victory follows." Another man protested, wanting to claim a valuable part.
"Then his golden tongue is mine, it is said to keep away all bad luck." A third voice joined in, each cultist eager to claim a piece.
The more Shitless listened the paler he became, the blood draining from his face, yet the smile didn't fade from his lips, had he taken over Vritra's luck somehow?
He was just observing the place when these cultist kidnapped him and threw him into this temple, at first Shitless felt he was going to become the god of higher beings, promoted to divinity.
But his evil thoughts were soon shattered like glass.
As everyone divided his body parts with enthusiasm, arguing over who gets what, the last guy and two other guys could only sigh heavily and settle for what was left over.
"Fine, I will take his hips, making them into a seat will bring great karma and enlightenment whenever someone sit on that." One resigned fellow muttered.
"I will take his that and turn into a big business, it will boost the stamina and potency of everyone!" the final guy had even thought of a business idea, his mind already calculating profits.
STEP STEP
Just then they noticed someone entering the temple, the footsteps echoing against the stone floor, many frowned since nothing was left to share among themselves.
So they would have to cut their own gains in half, and none wanted that, preferring to keep their full portions.
But when they turned and saw who it was, they all frowned deeply, recognition and fear flashing across their faces, Vritra's reputation had spread far and wide across the realm.
First he was a war veteran, powerful and very respected among higher beings, he had even risen to the power of the commander, a position of great authority.
Yet many years back, in a war against the Crooked, many higher beings had died in combat.
At that time, he somehow managed to survive but Evelyn, the daughter of Fader Vespera and the one leading the war, disappeared without a trace.
The joy of survival disappeared from him then, replaced by despair, he was even punished severely and so his personality became shit and he had retired from active duty.
Thankfully Evelyn had returned alive not long after, but the damage was already done to his reputation and psyche.
So, they were fearful of his prowess and his legendary temper, none daring to get close to him.
"What is happening here?" Vritra took in the expressions of all the cultists carefully and asked with dangerous calmness.

"N- Nothing, we just found a great buddha who possess great fortune and karma, s- so..." the youngest guy who only got Shitless's secret part and planned to start the business, spoke fearfully, his voice shaking.
But stopped when the guy beside him hit his feet hard, silencing him.
"Oh, a great buddha? It will bring me great luck?" instantly a smile stretched over his face, predatory and cold.
And seeing that smile, everyone in the temple had a bad feeling, a sense of foreboding settling over them like a heavy blanket.
"Hey, great buddha, wanna come with me? I will hang you on my house's wall so I can get the good luck." Vritra asked in a casual tone, but it wasn't really a question, it was a command.
"Amitabha~" Shitless looked towards Vritra with relief flooding his features, hiding his immense joy behind the serene expression.
Vritra really is his saviour, coming to save the damsel in distress just before he got dissected into pieces by these maniacs.

"Benefactor, it seems I owe you karmic debt from previous lifetime, please let me repay you now by becoming your good luck charm." Shitless said as he quickly jumped off the platform with surprising agility.
But the expressions of all the higher beings became unsightly at this revelation, they all were fuming with rage and disappointment.
This Baldy was theirs, they found him first, how can they let him take it and walk away with their prize?
"V- Vritra, don't go too far, w- we can give you his eyes or brain if you want but don't push us into a corner!" one guy took a step back nervously and muttered in barely controlled rage.

"We will complaint to the law holders, just take a body part or two and leave." Another voice sounded, from somewhere behind the group yet none could tell who had spoken, hidden among the white robes.
Vritra rolled his eyes at their threats, it seems Divine had arranged a good identity for him, he can clearly see the fear etched in their eyes.
So he acted more domineering and aggressive, even though logically any of them could kill him with an accidental sneeze if they wanted to.

"This buddha is mine, find your own, if you got a problem with it then you are free to attack me, I dare you to fight me." Vritra said with absolute confidence, as Shitless quickly appeared beside him.
Maintaining the same serene smile despite his racing heart.
Outside the temple, green pickle grinned widely with satisfaction and anticipation.
Who would have thought?
Really! Who would have thought that he wouldn't need to follow Vritra for months, the opportunity arose so quickly and conveniently.
Without wasting any time, he contacted the Law Holders with urgency.
In a distant part of the higher being realm, in a location far removed from the temple.
Inside a large office like building, various higher beings who were from the Vespera family, were busy working at their stations.
They sat and received complaints from the people, then deciding how to deal with each case meticulously.
Every now and then, they would leave the building to deal with matters personally, handling issues that required their authority.
But today something was different, a change in the atmosphere itself, since an extremely beautiful lady was standing inside the hall, her presence commanding attention.
Making the environment tense and suffocating, the pressure evident to all who worked there.
It was none other than Evelyn Vespera, who had suddenly decided to make a trip to this place without warning.
And had been here for around an hour, observing the proceedings.
Wherever someone walked out to personally go over and solve the case, she would check the case first, reviewing it herself.
But with their low status, what can they say or do in response to her scrutiny?
Just then, one of the man received a complaint from someone who made frequent complaints, becoming a regular nuisance.
"Ugh This Green turd..." grimacing at the notification, the man responded professionally: "Yes sir tur- COUGH how can I help you today?"

"Hurry up and quickly come here, there is a big robbery happening in bright day light at the Buddha temple!!" green pickle's hurried and panicked voice sounded through the connection, breathless with excitement.
The man frowned and asked again skeptically: "This is not some stupid thing again, right?" He had heard plenty of false reports before.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 877 Evelyn's Captive
paragraphs: "What stupid? How dare you- ugh just come to this place quickly, there is a madman who is stealing from the temple."
Green pickle cut the connection, not giving him time to respond further.
CLICK
The man sighed deeply, he really didn't want to go but that green turd is too annoying and persistent.
If the man didn't go, that green turd would file a complaint against him and his record would suffer.
"SIGH I will arrest him for false report, if it's against something shitty." He stood up slowly and gave the details to another person nearby, before walking towards the exit.
"What is it?" Evelyn asked suddenly, her cold emotionless voice sounding pleasant to the ear but induced fear and dread in them nonetheless.
"T- This..." the man raised a small jade like tablet hesitantly, handing it over to her with shaking hands.
This tablet was used to record all the details of the case from the time of the call to the end of the case, a complete record.
It even recorded the video of how the law holder solved the problem, everything documented for review.
The laws had become extremely strict under Fader and Evelyn, which is why many people wanted to replaced them with more lenient leaders.
Evelyn took the slip and instantly scanned it with her divine senses, quickly going over all the details methodically and instantly her eyes shone with interest and recognition.
'He is here!' A brilliant smile almost appeared on her face, breaking through her usual stoic expression, but she maintained her solemn look with effort.
"I will go personally look this over, or those heretics will cause problems again." She said calmly and before the man could say anything in response, she turned and walked out with purpose.
"Uh..." the officer was left there speechless, completely stunned by her sudden departure, but then felt happy at being relieved of the task.
Good riddance, he really didn't want to deal with all that stress and so he returned to his seat happily and gratefully.
Just as Evelyn was about to teleport near the temple using her power, she frowned suddenly and asked with sharp awareness: "How long are you planning to follow me around?"

"Ah You found me? Since when? As expected, my strength is still lacking compared to you." A thin veil seemed to disappear from the air as a man with a pleased smile stepped forward confidently, a paper fan in his hand.
Armin looked happily at his fiancée with obvious affection, ever since winning that bet against Len, he had been in a great mood and high spirits.
His father had started to trust him more and started to shift responsibilities of the family to him gradually, giving him more authority.
Soon, he can take over his father's seat completely and be the ruler of the underworld, receiving a high status and power.
As for Evelyn, his marriage to her was all but guaranteed in his mind, assured by the family agreement.
Surely, she will accept him eventually and if she didn't, he will make her accept him through various means.
In the future, the Vespera and Garissa family will both be his, the law and underworld belonging to him alone.
"What are you here for?" Evelyn asked in her usual manner, her tone and expression as cold as always, unmoved by his presence.
"Haha I am just here to spend time with my fiancée, what's wrong with that? Where are you going?" Armin asked casually, he had gotten used to her attitude by now, expecting nothing more.
"Just a case." She said simply then turned and left without further explanation.

"!!!" Armin stood there in surprise, stunned into silence for a moment, he expected that she would frown and ask him to leave immediately. But not only she replied to him, she didn't even say anything disrespectful, not asking him to leave or forbidding him from following.
Is she already accepting him as her future husband?
Stars shone in his eyes with hope and elation, so she indirectly gave him permission to follow her without objection?
His mood brightened even more as he followed Evelyn eagerly and disappeared from sight.
Inside the temple, Vritra's gaze swept over the people around him carefully but none dared to come closer to him, maintaining distance.
So he turned and started walking away slowly, Shitless flowing close by his side, still maintaining that serene expression.
Outside, green pickle grinned widely with satisfaction, waiting for the law holders to arrive and apprehend Vritra.
"S- Stop, I am calling the law holders!" one guy warned as they all followed behind Vritra, not ready to let him leave.
But just then, a light flashed suddenly and brightly, and then two figures appeared one after another in quick succession.
All people turned to look at the arrivals and were all shocked by who they saw, from green pickle to Vritra and all others present were equally surprised.
Who wouldn't know Evelyn here? She was famous throughout the realm.
"Hmm?" Armin glanced at everyone present around him slowly, his gaze pausing on Vritra for a moment, studying him carefully.
He felt he had seen Vritra somewhere before, his features seeming familiar, but then again, so what? Maybe he really had, its nothing big enough to worry about now.
Instead, all he focussed on was Evelyn and her presence.
"Who filed the complaint?" Evelyn asked, glancing at everyone present with her piercing gaze.
Although she looked calm and indifferent on the surface, but her heart almost leapt out of her chest at the sight of Vritra standing there alive.
He is finally here! Her man is here in front of her!!
This was exactly why she didn't stop Armin from following her, his luck has just run out completely and wouldn't it be great when he sees Vritra and her together?
Just the thought was exhilarating, his expressions would be priceless when he finds about her true relation with Vritra.
The higher beings in the white attires all looked at one another nervously, wondering who has such high connections that they directly called Evelyn herself to handle this matter.
Just then, the grass rustled beneath their feet and green pickle tremblingly walked out from his hiding spot, stepping into view.
He was so happy he could barely contain himself! His plan had worked perfectly!
The last time, it was Evelyn who had punished him for interfering, she seems to not like this guy much based on her expression back then.
Probably because she feels he had abandoned her in that dangerous realm during the war and ran on his own, saving himself.
So this time too, he will get punished severely for his crimes.
'Evelyn... she is finally here.' Vritra looked at the beautiful blonde woman, whose beauty was no lower than Teresa's, perfectly poised and elegant.
"I- It was me! I filed the complaint that he was stealing something f- from the temple!" green pickle quickly spoke up eagerly, stepping forward.
"You came here for such a small matter... hmm- oh, it is that commander!" Armin was doubtful at first then a look of realisation appeared on his face suddenly.
"Should I just eliminate him?" Armin asked confidently, glaring towards Vritra with hostility.

chapters.title: Chapter 878 Romance in the Office
paragraphs: "Should I just eliminate him?" Armin asked confidently, his hand already moving to his paper fan.
"And what is he trying to steal?" Evelyn ignored Armin completely and questioned further, her gaze locked solely on Vritra with intense focus.

"T-That Baldy Buddha. He was trying to steal the property of the temple. Please give him the h-harshest punishment!" Green Pickle spoke before the cultist could respond, his voice trembling with eagerness, desperate to see Vritra punished.

"I see." She nodded thoughtfully, her expression unreadable, and after a moment's pause continued with measured words, "I will be confiscating this Buddha for further research. As for him, I will give the harshest punishment possible."
"Yessss!" Green Pickle jumped in joy, unable to contain his excitement any longer. Finally, he had succeeded in his revenge after all this time.
Maybe Vritra would die this time, or at least spend a very long time suffering in prison, locked away and forgotten.
Finally, he had saved all those seven women, Vritra's mother, wife, and daughters, protecting them from his cruelty and abuse.
He wanted to go back and quickly tell them this good news, about his heroic actions and bravery. How happy would they be? Maybe they might just fall in love with him for saving them from such a man.
There is always a chance for romance to bloom in such circumstances.
The cultists, on the other hand, weren't so happy about the outcome. This Buddhist avatar meant quite a bit to them spiritually and materially.
It was pure luck that they had found one so easily without extensive searching throughout the realm.

Normally, they searched far and wide for such good Buddhist avatars so they could reap the benefits, but what could they even say in this matter with Evelyn here, her presence shutting down any objections?
In the end, they could only sigh heavily and give up, accepting their loss with resignation.
Evelyn wasted not a moment more in the midst of all these side characters and distractions. She just wanted to rush away with Vritra and be alone with him.
She looked at Shitless briefly, and with a gesture of her finger, he turned into a ray of light and disappeared into the distance rapidly.
None of them could tell where he had gone or how it was done so easily, but Shitless was already back in the House of Darkness, transported instantly through space.
Thankfully, he had survived his ordeal relatively unscathed. Maybe staying here as Shitless might not be such a bad idea after all, considering the alternative.
After sending him away to safety without hesitation, Evelyn didn't spare anyone even an extra glance as she took a step forward and flashed before Vritra.
She grabbed his hand gently but firmly with purpose, and the two simply disappeared from sight, leaving the crowd baffled and confused once again.
'Was this normal?'
They all wondered in stunned silence, their minds struggling to process what they had witnessed. Armin was especially in shock, his entire world shaking and crumbling.

Evelyn always maintained her distance from others and kept people at arm's length, treating everyone with cold professionalism. He was her fiancé, yet she stayed away from him as if he were carrying some disgusting plague. He hadn't even gotten to hold her hand once.
Neither had he ever seen her touch anyone else like that, with such obvious affection and possessiveness in her grip.
So what happened just now? She clearly seemed to know that man intimately. Maybe she even cared about him deeply.
She hated that man so much based on her previous punishments. Maybe it was just a way to make sure he wouldn't run away and escape from her custody?
Armin felt unsettled and confused by the sudden turn of events, but surely she wouldn't like someone like that, would she?
Right? RIGHT?

"So admirable, she must have already torn away that hand. How ruthless!" Green Pickle suddenly exclaimed loudly, clapping enthusiastically, bringing Armin back to his senses from his spiraling thoughts.
'Ah, right. That must be it. In battle, that is normal.' Finally, he felt at ease, accepting the explanation and letting it soothe his doubts.
The surrounding people only now noticed that Armin from the Garissa Family was present among them. Evelyn's presence had completely overshadowed his existence there.

They all quickly bowed and greeted him respectfully, their movements hurried and deferential, to which Armin nodded gracefully and responded politely, though his mind was elsewhere, though he only wanted to leave quickly and watch Evelyn torture that guy in her dungeons.
She was pretty ruthless to everyone except her family, showing no mercy to those who crossed her.

Even though her family treated her like a tradable object, a pawn in their schemes, she didn't actually seem to hate them that much. If he were in her place, he might have run away or rebelled completely against such treatment. Her strength should have been enough to do so.
The people around him kept trying to flatter him and gain his attention, stopping him from leaving the area and engaging him in tedious conversations.
He sighed heavily, feeling trapped, and only after quite a while was he finally able to leave, heading straight toward the Law Holders Headquarters to find Evelyn.
Only, she wasn't there.
Vritra was once again kidnapped by Evelyn, pulled away without warning, and he could only allow himself to be dragged along without resistance.
He knew she would surely come to find him eventually, just not this soon or this openly for everyone to see.
He didn't even have time to ask anything before finding himself standing inside a room that looked somewhat like an office, clearly a place of power and authority.
"...Where are we?" he asked, looking around the spacious room carefully. It was tidy and luxurious beyond measure.
The table, chair, papers, and even the pen appeared to be treasures that couldn't be found even among Demi Gods, each item radiating subtle power.
"This is my office as the Chancellor of the Higher Beings, ranked just below my father in the hierarchy." Evelyn replied with a sweet smile on her face, her expression softening as she looked at him.
"Forget that, my love..." she said warmly.
Cutting off any further questions before he could ask them, she moved closer to him with determined steps, her arms resting over his shoulders before wrapping around his neck gently.
Her soft body pressed against his, warm and inviting, and her fragrance surrounded Vritra, intoxicating his senses.
"Did you miss me?" Evelyn asked, looking at his face to her heart's content, drinking in the sight of him.
Who would have thought such a day would really come? She had worked so hard for moments like this, sacrificing much for this opportunity.
"...Not really." Vritra said, his tone matter-of-fact, gently moving out of her embrace before walking toward her table.
Aside from her father, Vritra was the only person to ever enter her office. She had even attacked Armin viciously when he once tried to enter just to chat with her casually.
Since that incident, he would at most stand outside waiting.
But Evelyn felt euphoric to have him here, walking freely in her private space.

Forget getting angry over him touching her things, she was delighted by it. She even remembered everything he had touched, every surface his hand had made contact with. Those items had now become priceless treasures in her eyes, more valuable than their original worth.
Vritra walked to the other side of the table slowly, casually sat down on the chair, and was instantly surprised by the effects it had on his body.
Not only did his mind calm down and center, but the flow of mana throughout his body became even smoother and more harmonious.
Even Gods would drool over such treasures, their mouths watering with envy. The status of the Higher Beings was truly on another level entirely.
He had also come to understand just how arrogant these people were in their superiority. Even Gods were merely lowly servants in their eyes, beneath their notice.
Just how had Evelyn fallen in love with him then, a mere Demi God?
Even with that pill and all the time they had spent together, considering the character of the Higher Beings, they normally wouldn't even look at a mere human, let alone a demi god.
So... was she different from the others?
His thoughts broke as an enticing scene unfolded right before him, stealing his attention completely.
Evelyn climbed onto the table with deliberate grace, her figure and posture incredibly sexy as she slowly crawled toward him on all fours.
At some point, her clothes had changed into a loose, sexy pink robe that barely contained her curves, the fabric falling open slightly.
As she stopped before Vritra, her smooth, snowy cleavage was laid bare before him, perfectly displayed.
Feeling his fiery gaze on her body, burning with desire, Evelyn didn't feel shy despite doing something so embarrassing and daring.
If her man liked it, she could do this and even more, anything he desired.
First, Evelyn leaned back slightly, creating distance between them teasingly.
Then her thick, milky thigh moved closer to Vritra, brushing against his arm as she settled both of her legs on either side of him deliberately.
She then pushed herself forward smoothly, softly landing on his lap while facing him, her legs dangling comfortably on both sides of his body.
The entire movement was incredibly seductive and practiced, their bodies now pressed tightly together intimately, their breaths mingling in the warm air of the office.
KNOCK KNOCK
The sound of knocking interrupted the moment, breaking the spell.
Thanks for reading...

chapters.title: Chapter 879 Her First Request
paragraphs: Armin after departing from the temple went straight to the headquarters of the law holders with purpose and determination.
But upon returning he couldn't see Evelyn or that criminal she had arrested anywhere in the building, no matter where he searched.
And when he asked the officers there, Armin found that Evelyn had never returned to the headquarters after leaving the temple.
So he thought carefully, maybe the punishment was too cruel to be displayed publicly or she wanted to deal with Vritra on her own in private.
Not according to the rules that were supposed to be followed.
With this in mind, he decided to check other places and find Evelyn, determined in his pursuit, no matter what he is going to make her fall for him eventually.
KNOCK KNOCK
Evelyn's lips was not even an inch apart from Vritra's, their bodies' desires mingling together in the heated atmosphere.
Yet the sudden knock interrupted it all, the sound jarring, putting a frown on Evelyn's beautiful face.

She glanced towards the door with irritation and found it was a maid, standing hesitantly outside, for a moment her killing intent burst forth with intensity, enough to turn the maid into a meat paste.
But she quickly suppressed it, forcing the dangerous aura back down, not wanting to hurt Vritra even by accident or stray energy.
"What is it?" she asked, her voice cold, the anger in her voice barely suppressed beneath a thin layer of civility.
"S- Sir Armin from the Garissa family is asking about you, I- I told him I will check the office." The maid replied nervously, her voice shaking slightly. She was a goddess in her own right.
Yet in here, her status was so low and insignificant. But being able to work for Evelyn Vespera, her status elsewhere in the realm would be very high and respected.
Many higher beings would also be afraid to offend her, knowing her connections.
Evelyn fell silent upon hearing it, her mind working quickly, thinking of what to do about this intrusion.
Vritra chuckled softly, his hands resting over her waist, feeling the softness of her breasts and ass through the thin fabric.
"Dragging a man here, sitting on his lap, being so intimately close, won't your fiancé get mad if he finds out?" he asked teasingly, a smirk playing on his lips.
Since he already has so many wives and Yasmine is pregnant, so he tried his best to not get another wife, to avoid further complications.
Yet Evelyn kept crashing into his life persistently and he knew for sure, there was no way to stop her or escape from her grasp.
Thus, his resistance slowly crumbled over time.

"I am sure he will be very mad, so will you help me turn that madness into despair?" Evelyn asked playfully, knowing fully well how Vritra dealt with anyone getting close to his women with romantic intentions.
Just Jack and Max had such bad fates for daring to approach his loves.
"Hmmm Since you have helped me so much already, I guess I can do that much for you." Vritra hummed after thinking for a bit, considering the request.
With a thought, misty essence mythic halo created floating letters in the air silently, telling her what to speak to the maid.
She smiled upon reading it, understanding his plan perfectly, and did as he said: "Tell him I am in the office."
Outside, Armin was just checking a few places around the building but internally he knew even if she was here, she would refuse to meet him as usual.
So, for today, he was just prepared to leave the headquarters, turning to walk away, but then the maid came hurriedly.
"Chancellor told me to inform you that she is inside the office." The maid said carefully, using Evelyn's formal title and position.
"Oh, did she ask me to leave?" Armin asked, his eyes shining with hope and excitement at the prospect.
"No, I wasn't given any further instructions." She replied honestly, having only been told to deliver the message.
Without asking anything further, Armin walked into the building eagerly. This whole building belonged to Evelyn, her main office was present here on the top floor.
After entering with a big smile on his face, he stopped right before the office door and asked loudly:
"Evelyn, are you inside?"
"Mmm~" a faint muffled hum came from inside, the sound strange and unusual but Armin didn't think too much of it, didn't question it.
While inside, Vritra's and Evelyn's bodies were pressed tightly together in an intimate embrace, arms wrapped around each other's bodies, feeling the warmth and body heat.
Their lips were sealed in a hot steamy kiss, passionate and deep, as Evelyn's tongue boldly entangled with his, hungrily savouring his taste and drinking his saliva greedily.
She pulled his tongue into her mouth, nibbling and sucking on it with wild abandon, as if truly trying to devour him completely.
But none of the sound travelled outside thanks to the soundproofing enchantments in place.
"Have you already dealt with that criminal?" Armin asked from outside, leaning against the wall casually and fanning himself with the paper fan.
"Y- Yea..." Evelyn seemed almost out of breath while answering, her voice slightly strained, but doing this while knowing Armin is outside made it more exciting and thrilling somehow.
"What's wrong? Are you okay?" Armin asked worriedly from the hallway, his eyes narrowing with concern.
Various possibilities instantly surfaced in his mind naturally, but he quickly cleared half of them, there is no way another man would be inside her private office.
There was a brief pause inside, as Evelyn found herself lost completely in the taste she had longed for, feeling his hands roam on her body with ownership.
Her heart leapt seeing that he was no longer rejecting her advances as he had before.
Her most special person, finally is with her willingly; Evelyn's feelings couldn't be explained in words, too complex and deep.
After a few moments, their lips parted as she licked her lips slowly, savoring the taste, and finally answered: "I am fine."
Taking a deep breath, she spoke before any more questions could be asked from outside: "Armin"
"Hmm?" yet again, Armin was surprised by her calling out to him directly.
Was this the first time she had called out his name? at least, the first time when he didn't notice any killing intent in her voice, what was happening exactly?
Weren't things moving too fast? She really is accepting him finally!!
"Yes? What is it?" he spoke eagerly, ready to do anything as her biggest simp, willing to fulfill any request.

"Can you get me ten orbs for demi gods level 8, 9 and 10 each?" Evelyn asked, her voice controlled and calm once more, while her gaze remained fixed on Vritra intensely, her heart just won't calm down.
She was going so crazy that all sorts of thoughts were appearing in her mind unbidden. Thoughts like annihilating her entire family so she can directly lie with Vritra without restrictions.
But then she shook her head mentally, how can she kill her family? But why not? Just get rid of her grandfather, father, his second wife, and that idiotic son of the second wife.
Yet just as the thought formed completely, it was dispelled as if something in her deeply resisted it, pulling back.
She just cannot go against them, she realized, yea, they are her family after all.
Vritra noticed her rapidly changing expressions, the conflict on her face, he touched her cheek gently which finally calmed her down.

"My son, I have been waiting for you for so many years SOB that bastard divine stole SOB you from home, and s- since SOB then I couldn't find you." His voice cracked with emotion, each word weighted with years of longing.

While crying, he continued: "He wanted to keep you as his pet and to use you to blackmail me, but when I refused, he just kidnapped you." The accusation was delivered with a strange mixture of sorrow and conviction.

Shitless who was suddenly embraced by the tall burly monk was at a loss of words, his body stiffening in surprise. Although the monk was crying, he seemed to be the serious type, yet the image had already crumbled under the weight of his emotions.

After being dazed for a few moments, Shitless freed himself and took a step back then spoke firmly: "I ran on my own, and he is my pet now." There was defiance in his voice, a stubborn pride that refused to be swept away.
But thinking of that, sadness appeared in Shitless's eyes, he instinctively touched his bald head. His poor hair gone forever—a loss he was reminded of constantly.

"But... But why would you, son? SOB You were my successor, sooner or later reaching the higher being level, ruling over so many!" crying monk just couldn't understand, his voice rising in pitch. Why would anyone run from all that? The question seemed genuinely alien to him.
Although one needs to prove their evil nature but being his son, Shitless would certainly have gotten his throne without struggle, without the bloodshed that usually came with such claims.
"It's because of mother, s- she... because of her, all my hairs are gone, my head still hurts from those smacks I received from her." Shitless's voice grew quiet, haunted by the memories.
The crying monk was stunned, his tears pausing for just a moment as confusion washed over his features. Then he said in disbelief:
"But your mother had been in close door seclusion for several years soon after giving birth to you, how is that even possible?" The logic didn't add up, and it showed clearly on his face.

Now it was Shitless's turn to be stunned, the realization hitting him like a blow. After forcing his single brain cell to work overtime he asked, his voice uncertain: "Uh... did you get a second wife then?"
"No, I only have one wife, that is your mother, even now." Crying Monk replied, his face a mask of honesty and sincerity.
"Then who was it..." Shitless touched his bald head and wondered, his hand lingering on the smooth scalp as the puzzle began to form in his mind.
WHISTLE~

Divine looked up at the pattern on the ceiling and whistled, an oddly cheerful sound that filled the sudden silence. Why was the room suddenly so hot? Maybe he should go out. The thought seemed to amuse him.
The father and son were dazed for a moment, their minds slowly connecting the dots that had been laid out before them, and then it clicked!
"It was you!" both exclaimed at the same time, their voices overlapping in unison.

It was divine who pretended to be his mother and made him bald by smacking his head for so long, the accumulated blows resulting in permanent hair loss. Finally, fed up and broken, Shitless ran away from home to escape the endless torment.

"So, I was kidnapped? My hair-" Shitless felt like murdering the divine, genuine homicidal intent flashing across his face. He lunged towards him with sudden fury, but divine transformed into an insect and flew away with surprising speed, his form too small to catch.

"Heh you can't kill what you can't touch." Divine laughed, his voice mocking and carefree, but then crying monk's staff swung through the air with deadly precision. The staff hit home with a thunderous crack, pasting him against the wall and leaving a small indentation in the structure.

For a few minutes, the father and son both took turns hitting the insect, their blows coordinated and relentless, but it was useless. The insect form was too fast, too maneuverable, slipping between each attack with ease.

So they could only stop, their shoulders heaving with exertion and frustration. Shitless was filled with even more anger, his face flushed with rage, but alas, his hair were already gone so thinking about them was pointless. What's done is done.
But I can still get my father's throne and reach the level of higher beings quickly! The thought sparked something within him, a hope that began to outweigh his anger.
With this thought, he felt a bit better, his breathing steadying. But then he thought of his father's earlier words and asked, his tone shifting to one of cautious optimism:
"Father, what did you mean by 'You were my successor'? am I not anymore?" The question hung in the air, the answer seemingly obvious yet desperately hoped against.
"Ah That..." crying monk's tears expanded further, covering more than half of his face in a fresh wave of sorrow.
"Hehe since you were gone, we were all aggrieved. So I had to call your mother out for a little over time." His voice took on an almost apologetic quality.
"..." Shitless was yet again speechless, the implications crashing down on him like a tidal wave. So his throne was gone too? Everything he had thought to gain was slipping through his fingers.
"How many?" he asked, his voice barely a whisper.

Crying monk wondered what he meant, the question seeming to catch him off guard. Then realizing something he replied, hesitation evident in his tone: "Well it was not easy, I had to try many times, but after 2,621 your mother was finally-"
Shitless interrupted him, unable to bear the suspense any longer: "I am asking, how many siblings do I have?" The words came out sharp, demanding.
